name: run_orElse
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_orElse {δ} [h : Backtrackable δ σ] (x₁ x₂ : EStateM ε σ α) (s : σ) :
    (x₁ <|> x₂).run s = match x₁.run s with
    | .ok x s => .ok x s
    | .error _ s' => x₂.run (restore s' (save s))
proof:
:= by
  show (EStateM.orElse _ _).run _ = _
  unfold EStateM.orElse
  simp only [EStateM.run]
  match x₁ s with | .ok _ _ => rfl | .error _ _ => simp

    | .ok x _ => some x

  rw [run', run_orElse]

    | .ok x s => .ok x s
    | .error e s' => (handler e).run (restore s' (save s))

:= by
  show (EStateM.tryCatch _ _).run _ = _

  simp only [EStateM.run]

    | .ok x _ => some x

name: run_tryFinally'
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_tryFinally' (x : EStateM ε σ α)
    (h : Option α → EStateM ε σ β) (s : σ) : (tryFinally' x h).run s = match x.run s with
    | .ok a s => match (h (some a)).run s with
      | .ok b s => Result.ok (a, b) s
      | .error e s => Result.error e s
    | .error e₁ s => match (h none).run s with
      | .ok _ s => Result.error e₁ s
      | .error e₂ s => Result.error e₂ s

name: run'_tryFinally'
statement:
@[simp] theorem run'_tryFinally' (x : EStateM ε σ α)
    (h : Option α → EStateM ε σ β) (s : σ) :
    (tryFinally' x h).run' s = match x.run s with
    | .ok a s => Option.map (a, ·) ((h (some a)).run' s)
    | .error _ _ => none
proof:
:= by
  simp [run', run_tryFinally']
  match x.run s with
  | .ok a s => simp only; cases (h (some a)).run s <;> rfl
  | .error e s => simp only; cases (h none).run s <;> rfl

theorem OrientedOrd.instOrdLex' (ord₁ ord₂ : Ord α) [@OrientedOrd _ ord₁] [@OrientedOrd _ ord₂] :

name: LawfulLTCmp.eq_compareOfLessAndEq
statement:
theorem LawfulLTCmp.eq_compareOfLessAndEq
    [LT α] [DecidableEq α] [LawfulEqCmp cmp] [LawfulLTCmp cmp]
    (x y : α) [Decidable (x < y)] : cmp x y = compareOfLessAndEq x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compareOfLessAndEq]
  split <;> rename_i h1 <;> [skip; split <;> rename_i h2]
  · exact LawfulLTCmp.eq_lt_iff_lt.2 h1
  · exact LawfulEqCmp.compare_eq_iff_eq.2 h2
  · cases e : cmp x y
    · cases h1 (LawfulLTCmp.eq_lt_iff_lt.1 e)
    · cases h2 (LawfulEqCmp.compare_eq_iff_eq.1 e)
    · rfl

name: ReflCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_lt_irrefl
statement:
theorem ReflCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_lt_irrefl [LT α] [DecidableLT α] [DecidableEq α]
    (lt_irrefl : ∀ x : α, ¬ x < x) :
    ReflCmp (α := α) (compareOfLessAndEq · ·) where
  compare_self {x}

name: LawfulBEqCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_lt_irrefl
statement:
theorem LawfulBEqCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_lt_irrefl
    [LT α] [DecidableLT α] [DecidableEq α] [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α]
    (lt_irrefl : ∀ x : α, ¬x < x) :
    LawfulBEqCmp (α := α) (compareOfLessAndEq · ·) where
  compare_eq_iff_beq {x y}
proof:
:= by
    simp [compareOfLessAndEq]
    split <;> [skip; split] <;> simp [*]
    rintro rfl; exact lt_irrefl _ ‹_›

name: TransCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_antisymm
statement:
theorem TransCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_antisymm
    [LT α] [DecidableLT α] [DecidableEq α]
    (lt_irrefl : ∀ x : α, ¬x < x)
    (lt_trans : ∀ {x y z : α}, x < y → y < z → x < z)
    (lt_antisymm : ∀ {x y : α}, ¬x < y → ¬y < x → x = y) :
    TransCmp (α := α) (compareOfLessAndEq · ·)
proof:
:=
  TransOrd.compareOfLessAndEq_of_lt_trans_of_lt_iff lt_trans <| by
    intros
    constructor
    · intro h₁
      constructor
      · intro h₂
        apply lt_irrefl
        exact lt_trans h₁ h₂
      · intro | rfl => exact lt_irrefl _ h₁
    · intro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
      by_contra h₃
      apply h₂
      exact lt_antisymm h₃ h₁

name: TransCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
statement:
theorem TransCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
    [LT α] [LE α] [DecidableLT α] [DecidableEq α]
    (lt_irrefl : ∀ x : α, ¬x < x)
    (lt_trans : ∀ {x y z : α}, x < y → y < z → x < z)
    (not_lt : ∀ {x y : α}, ¬x < y → y ≤ x)
    (le_antisymm : ∀ {x y : α}, x ≤ y → y ≤ x → x = y) :
    TransCmp (α := α) (compareOfLessAndEq · ·)
proof:
:=
  .compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_antisymm
    lt_irrefl lt_trans fun xy yx => le_antisymm (not_lt yx) (not_lt xy)

name: LawfulLTCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_antisymm
statement:
theorem LawfulLTCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_antisymm
    [LT α] [DecidableLT α] [DecidableEq α]
    (lt_irrefl : ∀ x : α, ¬x < x)
    (lt_trans : ∀ {x y z : α}, x < y → y < z → x < z)
    (lt_antisymm : ∀ {x y : α}, ¬x < y → ¬y < x → x = y) :
    LawfulLTCmp (α := α) (compareOfLessAndEq · ·)
proof:
:=
  { TransCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_antisymm
      lt_irrefl lt_trans lt_antisymm with
    eq_lt_iff_lt := Batteries.compareOfLessAndEq_eq_lt }

name: LawfulLTCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
statement:
theorem LawfulLTCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
    [LT α] [DecidableLT α] [DecidableEq α] [LE α]
    (lt_irrefl : ∀ x : α, ¬x < x)
    (lt_trans : ∀ {x y z : α}, x < y → y < z → x < z)
    (not_lt : ∀ {x y : α}, ¬x < y → y ≤ x)
    (le_antisymm : ∀ {x y : α}, x ≤ y → y ≤ x → x = y) :
    LawfulLTCmp (α := α) (compareOfLessAndEq · ·)
proof:
:=
  { TransCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
      lt_irrefl lt_trans not_lt le_antisymm with
    eq_lt_iff_lt := Batteries.compareOfLessAndEq_eq_lt }

name: LawfulLECmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
statement:
theorem LawfulLECmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
    [LT α] [DecidableLT α] [DecidableEq α] [LE α]
    (lt_irrefl : ∀ x : α, ¬x < x)
    (lt_trans : ∀ {x y z : α}, x < y → y < z → x < z)
    (not_lt : ∀ {x y : α}, ¬x < y ↔ y ≤ x)
    (le_antisymm : ∀ {x y : α}, x ≤ y → y ≤ x → x = y) :
    LawfulLECmp (α := α) (compareOfLessAndEq · ·)
proof:
:=
  have := TransCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
      lt_irrefl lt_trans not_lt.1 le_antisymm
  { this with
    isLE_iff_le := by
      intro x y
      simp only [Ordering.isLE_iff_ne_gt, ← not_lt]
      apply not_congr
      rw [this.gt_iff_lt, Batteries.compareOfLessAndEq_eq_lt] }

name: LawfulCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
statement:
theorem LawfulCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
    [LT α] [LE α] [DecidableLT α] [DecidableLE α] [DecidableEq α]
    (lt_irrefl : ∀ x : α, ¬x < x)
    (lt_trans : ∀ {x y z : α}, x < y → y < z → x < z)
    (not_lt : ∀ {x y : α}, ¬x < y ↔ y ≤ x)
    (le_antisymm : ∀ {x y : α}, x ≤ y → y ≤ x → x = y) :
    LawfulCmp (α := α) (compareOfLessAndEq · ·)
proof:
:=
    have instT := TransCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
      lt_irrefl lt_trans not_lt.1 le_antisymm
    have instLT := LawfulLTCmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
      lt_irrefl lt_trans not_lt.1 le_antisymm
    have instLE := LawfulLECmp.compareOfLessAndEq_of_irrefl_of_trans_of_not_lt_of_antisymm
      lt_irrefl lt_trans not_lt le_antisymm
    have le_refl (x : α) : x ≤ x := by rw [← not_lt]; exact lt_irrefl _
    have not_le {x y : α} : ¬x ≤ y ↔ y < x := by simp [← not_lt]
    { instT, instLT, instLE with
      eq_of_compare {_  _}:= by rw [compareOfLessAndEq_eq_eq le_refl not_le]; exact id
    }

name: ofBits_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ofBits_zero (f : Fin 0 → Bool) : ofBits f = 0

name: testBit_ofBits_lt
statement:
@[simp] theorem testBit_ofBits_lt {f : Fin n → Bool} (h : i < n) :
    (ofBits f).testBit i = f ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofBits]
  split
  · simp only [testBit, Nat.testBit_ofBits_lt, h]
  · have hlt := Nat.ofBits_lt_two_pow f
    simp [subNatNat_of_lt hlt, testBit, Nat.sub_sub, Nat.testBit_two_pow_sub_succ hlt, h]

name: testBit_ofBits_ge
statement:
@[simp] theorem testBit_ofBits_ge {f : Fin n → Bool} (h : i ≥ n) :
    (ofBits f).testBit i = decide (ofBits f < 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofBits]
  split
  · have hge : ¬ ofNat (Nat.ofBits f) < 0 := by rw [Int.not_lt]; exact natCast_nonneg ..
    simp only [testBit, Nat.testBit_ofBits_ge _ _ h, hge, decide_false]
  · have hlt := Nat.ofBits_lt_two_pow f
    have h : 2 ^ n - Nat.ofBits f - 1 < 2 ^ i :=
      Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right Nat.zero_lt_two h)
    simp [testBit, subNatNat_of_lt hlt, Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow h, negSucc_lt_zero]

name: testBit_ofBits
statement:
theorem testBit_ofBits (f : Fin n → Bool) :
    (ofBits f).testBit i = if h : i < n then f ⟨i, h⟩ else decide (ofBits f < 0)

name: getElem_eq_data_getElem
statement: theorem getElem_eq_data_getElem (a : ByteArray) (h : i < a.size) : a[i] = a.data[i]

name: uset_eq_set
statement:
@[simp] theorem uset_eq_set (a : ByteArray) {i : USize} (h : i.toNat < a.size) (v : UInt8) :
    a.uset i v h = a.set i.toNat v

name: data_mkEmpty
statement: @[simp] theorem data_mkEmpty (cap) : (emptyWithCapacity cap).data = #[]

name: get_push_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem get_push_eq (a : ByteArray) (x : UInt8) : (a.push x)[a.size] = x

name: get_push_lt
statement:
theorem get_push_lt (a : ByteArray) (x : UInt8) (i : Nat) (h : i < a.size) :
    (a.push x)[i]'(size_push .. ▸ Nat.lt_succ_of_lt h) = a[i]

name: size_set
statement:
@[simp] theorem size_set (a : ByteArray) (i : Fin a.size) (v : UInt8) :
    (a.set i v).size = a.size

name: get_set_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem get_set_eq (a : ByteArray) (i : Fin a.size) (v : UInt8) : (a.set i v)[i.val] = v

name: get_set_ne
statement:
theorem get_set_ne (a : ByteArray) (i : Fin a.size) (v : UInt8) (hj : j < a.size) (h : i.val ≠ j) :
    (a.set i v)[j]'(a.size_set .. ▸ hj) = a[j]

name: set_set
statement:
theorem set_set (a : ByteArray) (i : Fin a.size) (v v' : UInt8) :
    (a.set i v).set i v' = a.set i v'

name: data_copySlice
statement:
@[simp] theorem data_copySlice (a i b j len exact) :
  (copySlice a i b j len exact).data = b.data.extract 0 j ++ a.data.extract i (i + len)
    ++ b.data.extract (j + min len (a.data.size - i)) b.data.size

name: get_append_left
statement:
theorem get_append_left {a b : ByteArray} (hlt : i < a.size)
    (h : i < (a ++ b).size := size_append .. ▸ Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (Nat.le_add_right ..)) :
    (a ++ b)[i] = a[i]

name: get_append_right
statement:
theorem get_append_right {a b : ByteArray} (hle : a.size ≤ i) (h : i < (a ++ b).size)
    (h' : i - a.size < b.size := Nat.sub_lt_left_of_lt_add hle (size_append .. ▸ h)) :
    (a ++ b)[i] = b[i - a.size]

name: get_extract_aux
statement:
theorem get_extract_aux {a : ByteArray} {start stop} (h : i < (a.extract start stop).size) :
    start + i < a.size
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.add_lt_of_lt_sub'; apply Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h
  rw [size_extract, ← Nat.sub_min_sub_right]; exact Nat.min_le_right ..

name: get_extract
statement:
@[simp] theorem get_extract {a : ByteArray} {start stop} (h : i < (a.extract start stop).size) :
    (a.extract start stop)[i] = a[start+i]'(get_extract_aux h)

name: ofFn_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ofFn_zero (f : Fin 0 → UInt8) : ofFn f = empty

name: ofFn_succ
statement:
theorem ofFn_succ (f : Fin (n+1) → UInt8) :
    ofFn f = (ofFn fun i => f i.castSucc).push (f (Fin.last n))

name: data_ofFn
statement: @[simp] theorem data_ofFn (f : Fin n → UInt8) : (ofFn f).data = .ofFn f
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp [ofFn_succ, Array.ofFn_succ, ih, Fin.last]

name: size_ofFn
statement: @[simp] theorem size_ofFn (f : Fin n → UInt8) : (ofFn f).size = n

name: get_ofFn
statement:
@[simp] theorem get_ofFn (f : Fin n → UInt8) (i : Fin (ofFn f).size) :
    (ofFn f).get i = f (i.cast (size_ofFn f))

name: getElem_ofFn
statement:
@[simp] theorem getElem_ofFn (f : Fin n → UInt8) (i) (h : i < (ofFn f).size) :
    (ofFn f)[i] = f ⟨i, size_ofFn f ▸ h⟩

name: Heap.noSibling_merge
statement:
theorem Heap.noSibling_merge (le) (s₁ s₂ : Heap α) :
    (s₁.merge le s₂).NoSibling
proof:
:= by
  unfold merge
  (split <;> try split) <;> constructor

name: Heap.noSibling_combine
statement:
theorem Heap.noSibling_combine (le) (s : Heap α) :
    (s.combine le).NoSibling
proof:
:= by
  unfold combine; split
  · exact noSibling_merge _ _ _
  · match s with
    | nil | node _ _ nil => constructor
    | node _ _ (node _ _ s) => rename_i h; exact (h _ _ _ _ _ rfl).elim

name: Heap.noSibling_deleteMin
statement:
theorem Heap.noSibling_deleteMin {s : Heap α} (eq : s.deleteMin le = some (a, s')) :
    s'.NoSibling
proof:
:= by
  cases s with cases eq | node a c => exact noSibling_combine _ _

name: Heap.noSibling_tail
statement:
theorem Heap.noSibling_tail? {s : Heap α} : s.tail? le = some s' →
    s'.NoSibling
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail?]; intro eq
  match eq₂ : s.deleteMin le, eq with
  | some (a, tl), rfl => exact noSibling_deleteMin eq₂

name: Heap.noSibling_tail
statement: theorem Heap.noSibling_tail (le) (s : Heap α) : (s.tail le).NoSibling
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail]
  match eq : s.tail? le with
  | none => cases s with cases eq | nil => constructor
  | some tl => exact Heap.noSibling_tail? eq

name: Heap.size_merge_node
statement:
theorem Heap.size_merge_node (le) (a₁ : α) (c₁ s₁ : Heap α) (a₂ : α) (c₂ s₂ : Heap α) :
    (merge le (.node a₁ c₁ s₁) (.node a₂ c₂ s₂)).size = c₁.size + c₂.size + 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold merge; dsimp; split <;> simp +arith [size]

name: Heap.size_merge
statement:
theorem Heap.size_merge (le) {s₁ s₂ : Heap α} (h₁ : s₁.NoSibling) (h₂ : s₂.NoSibling) :
    (merge le s₁ s₂).size = s₁.size + s₂.size
proof:
:= by
  match h₁, h₂ with
  | .nil, .nil | .nil, .node _ _ | .node _ _, .nil => simp [merge, size]
  | .node _ _, .node _ _ => unfold merge; dsimp; split <;> simp +arith [size]

name: Heap.size_combine
statement:
theorem Heap.size_combine (le) (s : Heap α) :
    (s.combine le).size = s.size
proof:
:= by
  unfold combine; split
  · rename_i a₁ c₁ a₂ c₂ s
    rw [size_merge le (noSibling_merge _ _ _) (noSibling_combine _ _),
      size_merge_node, size_combine le s]
    simp +arith [size]
  · rfl

name: Heap.size_deleteMin
statement:
theorem Heap.size_deleteMin {s : Heap α} (h : s.NoSibling) (eq : s.deleteMin le = some (a, s')) :
    s.size = s'.size + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases h with cases eq | node a c => rw [size_combine, size, size]

name: Heap.size_tail
statement:
theorem Heap.size_tail? {s : Heap α} (h : s.NoSibling) : s.tail? le = some s' →
    s.size = s'.size + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail?]; intro eq
  match eq₂ : s.deleteMin le, eq with
  | some (a, tl), rfl => exact size_deleteMin h eq₂

name: Heap.size_tail
statement: theorem Heap.size_tail (le) {s : Heap α} (h : s.NoSibling) : (s.tail le).size = s.size - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail]
  match eq : s.tail? le with
  | none => cases s with cases eq | nil => rfl
  | some tl => simp [Heap.size_tail? h eq]

name: Heap.size_deleteMin_lt
statement:
theorem Heap.size_deleteMin_lt {s : Heap α} (eq : s.deleteMin le = some (a, s')) :
    s'.size < s.size
proof:
:= by
  cases s with cases eq | node a c => simp +arith [size_combine, size]

name: Heap.size_tail
statement:
theorem Heap.size_tail?_lt {s : Heap α} : s.tail? le = some s' →
    s'.size < s.size
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail?]; intro eq
  match eq₂ : s.deleteMin le, eq with
  | some (a, tl), rfl => exact size_deleteMin_lt eq₂

name: Heap.WF.singleton
statement: theorem Heap.WF.singleton : (Heap.singleton a).WF le

name: Heap.WF.merge_node
statement:
theorem Heap.WF.merge_node (h₁ : NodeWF le a₁ c₁) (h₂ : NodeWF le a₂ c₂) :
    (merge le (.node a₁ c₁ s₁) (.node a₂ c₂ s₂)).WF le
proof:
:= by
  unfold merge; dsimp
  split <;> rename_i h
  · exact node ⟨fun [_] => h, h₂, h₁⟩
  · exact node ⟨fun [_] => TotalBLE.total.resolve_left h, h₁, h₂⟩

name: Heap.WF.merge
statement:
theorem Heap.WF.merge (h₁ : s₁.WF le) (h₂ : s₂.WF le) :
    (merge le s₁ s₂).WF le
proof:
:=
  match h₁, h₂ with
  | .nil, .nil => nil
  | .nil, .node h₂ => node h₂
  | .node h₁, .nil => node h₁
  | .node h₁, .node h₂ => merge_node h₁ h₂

name: Heap.WF.combine
statement: theorem Heap.WF.combine (h : s.NodeWF le a) : (combine le s).WF le
proof:
:=
  match s with
  | .nil => nil
  | .node _b _c .nil => node h.2.1
  | .node _b₁ _c₁ (.node _b₂ _c₂ _s) => merge (merge_node h.2.1 h.2.2.2.1) (combine h.2.2.2.2)

name: Heap.WF.deleteMin
statement:
theorem Heap.WF.deleteMin {s : Heap α} (h : s.WF le)
    (eq : s.deleteMin le = some (a, s')) : s'.WF le
proof:
:= by
  cases h with cases eq | node h => exact Heap.WF.combine h

name: Heap.WF.tail
statement:
theorem Heap.WF.tail? (hwf : (s : Heap α).WF le) : s.tail? le = some tl →
  tl.WF le
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail?]; intro eq
  match eq₂ : s.deleteMin le, eq with
  | some (a, tl), rfl => exact hwf.deleteMin eq₂

name: Heap.WF.tail
statement: theorem Heap.WF.tail (hwf : (s : Heap α).WF le) : (s.tail le).WF le
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail]
  match eq : s.tail? le with
  | none => exact Heap.WF.nil
  | some tl => exact hwf.tail? eq

name: Heap.deleteMin_fst
statement: theorem Heap.deleteMin_fst : ((s : Heap α).deleteMin le).map (·.1) = s.head?

name: empty_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem empty_eq : (∅ : AssocList α β) = nil

name: isEmpty_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem isEmpty_eq (l : AssocList α β) : isEmpty l = l.toList.isEmpty
proof:

name: length_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem length_nil : length (nil : AssocList α β) = 0

name: length_cons
statement: @[simp] theorem length_cons : length (cons a b t) = length t + 1

name: length_toList
statement: theorem length_toList (l : AssocList α β) : l.toList.length = l.length

name: foldlM_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem foldlM_eq [Monad m] (f : δ → α → β → m δ) (init l) :
    foldlM f init l = l.toList.foldlM (fun d (a, b) => f d a b) init
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing init <;> simp [*, foldlM]

name: foldl_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem foldl_eq (f : δ → α → β → δ) (init l) :
    foldl f init l = l.toList.foldl (fun d (a, b) => f d a b) init

name: toList_eq_toListTR
statement: @[csimp] theorem toList_eq_toListTR : @toList = @toListTR
proof:

name: forM_eq

name: findEntryP
statement:

name: findEntry
statement:

name: find

:= by

name: find
statement:
@[simp] theorem find?_eq [BEq α] (a : α) (l : AssocList α β) :
    find? a l = (l.toList.find? (·.1 == a)).map (·.2)

name: any_eq
statement:

name: all_eq

name: toList_replace
statement:
@[simp] theorem toList_replace [BEq α] (a : α) (b : β) (l : AssocList α β) :
    (replace a b l).toList =
    l.toList.replaceF (bif ·.1 == a then some (a, b) else none)
proof:
:= by
  induction l <;> simp [replace]; split <;> simp [*]

name: length_replace
statement: @[simp] theorem length_replace [BEq α] {a : α} : (replace a b l).length = l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l
  · rfl
  · simp only [replace, length_cons]
    split <;> simp_all

name: toList_eraseP
statement:
@[simp] theorem toList_eraseP (p) (l : AssocList α β) :
    (eraseP p l).toList = l.toList.eraseP fun (a, b) => p a b
proof:
:= by
  induction l <;> simp [List.eraseP, cond]; split <;> simp [*]

name: toList_erase
statement:

name: toList_modify
statement:
@[simp] theorem toList_modify [BEq α] (a : α) (l : AssocList α β) :
    (modify a f l).toList =
    l.toList.replaceF fun (k, v) => bif k == a then some (a, f k v) else none
proof:
:= by
  simp [cond]
  induction l with simp [List.replaceF]
  | cons k v es ih => cases k == a <;> simp [ih]

name: length_modify
statement: @[simp] theorem length_modify [BEq α] {a : α} : (modify a f l).length = l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l
  · rfl
  · simp only [modify, length_cons]
    split <;> simp_all

name: forIn_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem forIn_eq [Monad m] (l : AssocList α β) (init : δ)
    (f : (α × β) → δ → m (ForInStep δ)) : forIn l init f = forIn l.toList init f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [forIn]
  induction l generalizing init <;> simp [AssocList.forIn]
  congr; funext a; split <;> simp [*]

name: beq_nil_cons
statement: @[simp] theorem beq_nil_cons [BEq α] [BEq β] : ((.nil : AssocList α β) == .cons a b t) = false

name: beq_cons_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem beq_cons_nil [BEq α] [BEq β] : ((.cons a b t : AssocList α β) == .nil) = false

name: beq_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem beq_cons₂ [BEq α] [BEq β] :
    ((.cons a b t : AssocList α β) == .cons a' b' t') = (a == a' && b == b' && t == t')

name: beq_eq
statement:
protected theorem beq_eq [BEq α] [BEq β] {l m : AssocList α β} :
    (l == m) = (l.toList == m.toList)
proof:
:= by
  simp [(· == ·)]
  induction l generalizing m <;> cases m <;> simp [*, (· == ·), AssocList.beq, List.beq]

name: fst_take_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem fst_take_zero [Stream σ α] (s : σ) :
    (take s 0).fst = []

name: fst_take_succ
statement:
theorem fst_take_succ [Stream σ α] (s : σ) :
    (take s (n+1)).fst = match next? s with
      | none => []
      | some (a, s) => a :: (take s n).fst

name: snd_take_eq_drop
statement:
@[simp] theorem snd_take_eq_drop [Stream σ α] (s : σ) (n : Nat) :
    (take s n).snd = drop s n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [take, drop]
    split <;> simp [ih]

name: fst_takeTR_loop
statement:
theorem fst_takeTR_loop [Stream σ α] (s : σ) (acc : List α) (n : Nat) :
    (takeTR.loop s acc n).fst = acc.reverseAux (take s n).fst
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing acc s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [take, takeTR.loop]; split; rfl; simp [ih]

name: fst_takeTR
statement: theorem fst_takeTR [Stream σ α] (s : σ) (n : Nat) : (takeTR s n).fst = (take s n).fst

name: snd_takeTR_loop
statement:
theorem snd_takeTR_loop [Stream σ α] (s : σ) (acc : List α) (n : Nat) :
    (takeTR.loop s acc n).snd = drop s n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing acc s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [takeTR.loop, drop]; split; rfl; simp [ih]

name: snd_takeTR
statement:
theorem snd_takeTR [Stream σ α] (s : σ) (n : Nat) :
    (takeTR s n).snd = drop s n

name: take_eq_takeTR
statement: @[csimp] theorem take_eq_takeTR : @take = @takeTR
proof:
:= by
  funext; ext : 1; rw [fst_takeTR]; rw [snd_takeTR, snd_take_eq_drop]

name: List.stream_drop_eq_drop
statement: @[simp] theorem List.stream_drop_eq_drop (l : List α) : Stream.drop l n = l.drop n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    match l with
    | [] => rfl
    | _::_ => simp [Stream.drop, Stream.next?, List.drop_succ_cons, ih]

name: List.stream_take_eq_take_drop
statement:
@[simp] theorem List.stream_take_eq_take_drop (l : List α) :
    Stream.take l n = (l.take n, l.drop n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    match l with
    | [] => rfl
    | _::_ => simp [Stream.take, Stream.next?, ih]

name: run_failure
statement:

    (failure : ReaderT ρ m α).run ctx = failure

name: run_orElse
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_orElse [Monad m] [Alternative m] (x y : ReaderT ρ m α) (ctx : ρ) :
    (x <|> y).run ctx = (x.run ctx <|> y.run ctx)

name: run_throw
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_throw [MonadExceptOf ε m] (e : ε) (ctx : ρ) :
    (throw e : ReaderT ρ m α).run ctx = throw e

name: run_throwThe
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_throwThe [MonadExceptOf ε m] (e : ε) (ctx : ρ) :
    (throwThe ε e : ReaderT ρ m α).run ctx = throwThe ε e

name: run_tryCatch
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_tryCatch [MonadExceptOf ε m]
    (body : ReaderT ρ m α) (handler : ε → ReaderT ρ m α) (ctx : ρ) :
    (tryCatch body handler).run ctx = tryCatch (body.run ctx) (handler · |>.run ctx)

name: run_tryCatchThe
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_tryCatchThe [MonadExceptOf ε m]
    (body : ReaderT ρ m α) (handler : ε → ReaderT ρ m α) (ctx : ρ) :
    (tryCatchThe ε body handler).run ctx = tryCatchThe ε (body.run ctx) (handler · |>.run ctx)

name: run_failure
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_failure {α σ} [Monad m] [Alternative m] (s : σ) :
    (failure : StateT σ m α).run s = failure

name: run_orElse
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_orElse {α σ} [Monad m] [Alternative m] (x y : StateT σ m α) (s : σ) :
    (x <|> y).run s = (x.run s <|> y.run s)

name: run_throw
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_throw [Monad m] [MonadExceptOf ε m] (e : ε) (s : σ) :
    (throw e : StateT σ m α).run s = (do let a ← throw e; pure (a, s))

name: run_throwThe
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_throwThe [Monad m] [MonadExceptOf ε m] (e : ε) (s : σ) :
    (throwThe ε e : StateT σ m α).run s = (do let a ← throwThe ε e; pure (a, s))

name: run_tryCatch
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_tryCatch [Monad m] [MonadExceptOf ε m]
    (body : StateT σ m α) (handler : ε → StateT σ m α) (s : σ) :
    (tryCatch body handler).run s = tryCatch (body.run s) (handler · |>.run s)

name: run_tryCatchThe
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_tryCatchThe [Monad m] [MonadExceptOf ε m]
    (body : StateT σ m α) (handler : ε → StateT σ m α) (s : σ) :
    (tryCatchThe ε body handler).run s = tryCatchThe ε (body.run s) (handler · |>.run s)

name: mapConst_failure
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapConst_failure [Alternative m] [LawfulAlternative m] (y : β) :
    Functor.mapConst y (failure : m α) = failure

name: mapConst_orElse
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapConst_orElse [Alternative m] [LawfulAlternative m] (x x' : m α) (y : β) :
    Functor.mapConst y (x <|> x') = (Functor.mapConst y x <|> Functor.mapConst y x')

name: failure_seqLeft
statement:
@[simp] theorem failure_seqLeft [Alternative m] [LawfulAlternative m] (x : m α) :
    (failure : m β) <* x = failure

name: failure_seqRight
statement:
@[simp] theorem failure_seqRight [Alternative m] [LawfulAlternative m] (x : m α) :
    (failure : m β) *> x = failure

name: failure_bind
statement:
@[simp] theorem failure_bind [AlternativeMonad m] [LawfulAlternative m] [LawfulMonad m]
    (x : α → m β) : failure >>= x = failure
proof:
:= by
  calc failure >>= x = (PEmpty.elim <$> failure) >>= x := by rw [map_failure]
    _ = failure >>= (x ∘ PEmpty.elim) := by rw [bind_map_left, Function.comp_def]
    _ = failure >>= (pure ∘ PEmpty.elim) := bind_congr fun a => a.elim
    _ = (PEmpty.elim <$> failure) >>= pure := by rw [bind_map_left, Function.comp_def]
    _ = failure := by rw [map_failure, bind_pure]

name: seq_failure
statement:
@[simp] theorem seq_failure [AlternativeMonad m] [LawfulAlternative m] [LawfulMonad m]
    (x : m (α → β)) : x <*> failure = x *> failure
proof:
:= by
  simp only [seq_eq_bind_map, map_failure, seqRight_eq, bind_map_left]

name: get_bind_set
statement:
@[simp] theorem get_bind_set :

proof:
:= by
  simpa only [bind_pure_comp, id_map', get_map_const] using

name: get_bind_map_set

name: set_bind_map_get

name: modifyThe_eq

statement:
@[simp] theorem set_bind_modifyGet (s : σ) (f : σ → α × σ) :

    (do set s; let x ← modifyGet f; mx x) = (do set (f s).2; mx (f s).1)

statement:
@[simp] theorem set_bind_getModify (s : σ) (f : σ → σ) :

name: set_bind_getModify_bind
statement:
@[simp] theorem set_bind_getModify_bind (s : σ) (f : σ → σ) (mx : σ → m α) :

statement:

statement:
theorem modify_comm_of_comp_comm {f g : σ → σ} (h : f ∘ g = g ∘ f) :

name: modify_bind_get
statement:

statement:
@[simp] theorem ForInStep.bindList_nil [Monad m] (f : α → β → m (ForInStep β))

name: ForInStep.bindList_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem ForInStep.bindList_cons [Monad m]
    (f : α → β → m (ForInStep β)) (s : ForInStep β) (a l) :
    s.bindList f (a::l) = s.bind fun b => f a b >>= (·.bindList f l)

statement:

name: ForInStep.bindList_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem ForInStep.bindList_append [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]

    s.bindList f (l₁ ++ l₂) = s.bindList f l₁ >>= (·.bindList f l₂)
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing s <;> simp [*]

name: Heap.findMin_val
statement: theorem Heap.findMin_val : ((s : Heap α).findMin le k res).val = s.headD le res.val
proof:
:=
  match s with
  | .nil => rfl
  | .cons r a c s => by rw [findMin, headD]; split <;> apply findMin_val

name: Heap.deleteMin_fst
statement: theorem Heap.deleteMin_fst : ((s : Heap α).deleteMin le).map (·.1) = s.head? le
proof:
:=
  match s with
  | .nil => rfl
  | .cons r a c s => by simp only [deleteMin, findMin_val, Option.map, head?]

name: HeapNode.WF.realSize_eq
statement:
theorem HeapNode.WF.realSize_eq :
    ∀ {n} {s : HeapNode α}, s.WF le a n → s.realSize + 1 = 2 ^ n
  | _, .nil, rfl => rfl
  | _, .node .., ⟨_, rfl, _, c, s⟩ => by
    rw [realSize, realSize_eq c, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_succ]
    simp [Nat.add_assoc, realSize_eq s]

name: HeapNode.rankTR_eq
statement: @[csimp] theorem HeapNode.rankTR_eq : @rankTR = @rank
proof:
:= by
  funext α s; exact go s 0

name: Heap.realSize_merge
statement:
theorem Heap.realSize_merge (le) (s₁ s₂ : Heap α) :
    (s₁.merge le s₂).realSize = s₁.realSize + s₂.realSize
proof:
:= by
  unfold merge; split
  · simp
  · simp
  · next r₁ a₁ n₁ t₁ r₂ a₂ n₂ t₂ =>
    have IH₁ r a n := realSize_merge le t₁ (cons r a n t₂)
    have IH₂ r a n := realSize_merge le (cons r a n t₁) t₂
    have IH₃ := realSize_merge le t₁ t₂
    split; · simp [IH₁, Nat.add_assoc]
    split; · simp [IH₂, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm]
    split; simp only; rename_i a n eq
    have : n.realSize = n₁.realSize + 1 + n₂.realSize := by
      rw [combine] at eq; split at eq <;> cases eq <;>
        simp [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm]
    split <;> split <;> simp [IH₁, IH₂, IH₃, this, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm]

name: Heap.realSize_findMin
statement:
private theorem Heap.realSize_findMin {s : Heap α}
    (m) (hk : ∀ s, (k s).realSize = m + s.realSize)
    (eq : n = m + s.realSize) (hres : res.HasSize n) :
    (s.findMin le k res).HasSize n
proof:
:=
  match s with
  | .nil => hres
  | .cons r a c s => by
    simp [findMin]
    refine realSize_findMin (m + c.realSize + 1)
      (by simp [hk, Nat.add_assoc]) (by simp [eq, Nat.add_assoc]) ?_
    split
    · exact hres
    · exact ⟨m, hk, by simp [eq, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]⟩

name: HeapNode.realSize_toHeap
statement: theorem HeapNode.realSize_toHeap (s : HeapNode α) : s.toHeap.realSize = s.realSize
proof:
:= go s where
  go {n res} : ∀ s : HeapNode α, (toHeap.go s n res).realSize = s.realSize + res.realSize
  | .nil => (Nat.zero_add _).symm
  | .node a c s => by simp [toHeap.go, go, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm]

name: Heap.realSize_deleteMin
statement:
theorem Heap.realSize_deleteMin {s : Heap α} (eq : s.deleteMin le = some (a, s')) :
    s.realSize = s'.realSize + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases s with cases eq | cons r a c s => ?_
  have : (s.findMin le (cons r a c) ⟨id, a, c, s⟩).HasSize (c.realSize + s.realSize + 1) :=
    Heap.realSize_findMin (c.realSize + 1) (by simp) (Nat.add_right_comm ..) ⟨0, by simp⟩
  revert this
  match s.findMin le (cons r a c) ⟨id, a, c, s⟩ with
  | { before, val, node, next } =>
    intro ⟨m, ih₁, ih₂⟩; dsimp only at ih₁ ih₂
    rw [realSize, Nat.add_right_comm, ih₂]
    simp only [realSize_merge, HeapNode.realSize_toHeap, ih₁, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm]

name: Heap.realSize_tail
statement:
theorem Heap.realSize_tail? {s : Heap α} : s.tail? le = some s' →
    s.realSize = s'.realSize + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail?]; intro eq
  match eq₂ : s.deleteMin le, eq with
  | some (a, tl), rfl => exact realSize_deleteMin eq₂

name: Heap.realSize_tail
statement: theorem Heap.realSize_tail (le) (s : Heap α) : (s.tail le).realSize = s.realSize - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail]
  match eq : s.tail? le with
  | none => cases s with cases eq | nil => rfl
  | some tl => simp [Heap.realSize_tail? eq]

name: Heap.WF.nil
statement: theorem Heap.WF.nil : Heap.nil.WF le n

name: Heap.WF.singleton
statement: theorem Heap.WF.singleton : (Heap.singleton a).WF le 0

name: Heap.WF.of_rankGT
statement: theorem Heap.WF.of_rankGT (hlt : s.rankGT n) (h : Heap.WF le n' s) : s.WF le (n+1)
proof:
:=
  match s with
  | .nil => trivial
  | .cons .. => let ⟨_, h₂, h₃⟩ := h; ⟨hlt, h₂, h₃⟩

name: Heap.WF.of_le
statement: theorem Heap.WF.of_le (hle : n ≤ n') (h : Heap.WF le n' s) : s.WF le n
proof:
:=
  match s with
  | .nil => trivial
  | .cons .. => let ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := h; ⟨Nat.le_trans hle h₁, h₂, h₃⟩

name: Heap.rankGT.of_le
statement: theorem Heap.rankGT.of_le (h : Heap.rankGT s n) (h' : n' ≤ n) : s.rankGT n'
proof:
:=
  match s with
  | .nil => trivial
  | .cons .. => Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h' h

name: Heap.WF.rankGT
statement: theorem Heap.WF.rankGT (h : Heap.WF lt (n+1) s) : s.rankGT n
proof:
:=
  match s with
  | .nil => trivial
  | .cons .. => Nat.lt_of_succ_le h.1

name: Heap.WF.merge'
statement:
theorem Heap.WF.merge' (h₁ : s₁.WF le n) (h₂ : s₂.WF le n) :
    (merge le s₁ s₂).WF le n ∧ ((s₁.rankGT n ↔ s₂.rankGT n) → (merge le s₁ s₂).rankGT n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold merge; split
  · exact ⟨h₂, fun h => h.1 h₁⟩
  · exact ⟨h₁, fun h => h.2 h₂⟩
  · rename_i r₁ a₁ n₁ t₁ r₂ a₂ n₂ t₂
    let ⟨hr₁, hn₁, ht₁⟩ := h₁
    let ⟨hr₂, hn₂, ht₂⟩ := h₂
    split <;> rename_i lt₁
    · refine ⟨⟨hr₁, hn₁, And.left (merge' ht₁ ⟨lt₁, hn₂, ht₂⟩)⟩, fun h => ?_⟩
      exact h.2 <| Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hr₁ lt₁
    split <;> rename_i lt₂
    · refine ⟨⟨hr₂, hn₂, And.left (merge' ⟨lt₂, hn₁, ht₁⟩ ht₂)⟩, fun h => ?_⟩
      exact h.1 <| Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hr₂ lt₂
    cases Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.ge_of_not_lt lt₂) (Nat.ge_of_not_lt lt₁)
    split; rename_i a n eq
    have : n.WF le a (r₁+1) := by
      unfold combine at eq; split at eq <;> cases eq <;> rename_i h
      · exact ⟨r₁, rfl, h, hn₂, hn₁⟩
      · exact ⟨r₁, rfl, TotalBLE.total.resolve_left h, hn₁, hn₂⟩
    simp only; split <;> split <;> rename_i hl₁ hl₂
    · exact ⟨⟨Nat.le_succ_of_le hr₁, this,
        (merge' (ht₁.of_rankGT hl₁) (ht₂.of_rankGT hl₂)).1⟩,
        fun _ => Nat.lt_succ_of_le hr₁⟩
    · let ⟨ih₁, ih₂⟩ := merge' (s₁ := .cons ..)
        ⟨Nat.le_succ_of_le hr₁, this, ht₁.of_rankGT hl₁⟩
        (ht₂.of_le (Nat.le_succ_of_le hr₁))
      exact ⟨ih₁, fun _ => ih₂ ⟨fun _ => ht₂.rankGT.of_le hr₁, fun _ => Nat.lt_succ_of_le hr₁⟩⟩
    · let ⟨ih₁, ih₂⟩ := merge' (s₂ := .cons ..) (ht₁.of_le (Nat.le_succ_of_le hr₁))
        ⟨Nat.le_succ_of_le hr₁, this, ht₂.of_rankGT hl₂⟩
      exact ⟨ih₁, fun _ => ih₂ ⟨fun _ => Nat.lt_succ_of_le hr₁, fun _ => ht₁.rankGT.of_le hr₁⟩⟩
    · let ⟨ih₁, ih₂⟩ := merge' ht₁ ht₂
      exact ⟨⟨Nat.le_succ_of_le hr₁, this, ih₁.of_rankGT (ih₂ (iff_of_false hl₁ hl₂))⟩,
        fun _ => Nat.lt_succ_of_le hr₁⟩

name: Heap.WF.merge
statement: theorem Heap.WF.merge (h₁ : s₁.WF le n) (h₂ : s₂.WF le n) : (merge le s₁ s₂).WF le n

name: HeapNode.WF.rank_eq
statement:
theorem HeapNode.WF.rank_eq : ∀ {n} {s : HeapNode α}, s.WF le a n → s.rank = n
  | _, .nil, h => h.symm
  | _, .node .., ⟨_, rfl, _, _, h⟩ => congrArg Nat.succ (rank_eq h)

name: HeapNode.WF.toHeap
statement: theorem HeapNode.WF.toHeap {s : HeapNode α} (h : s.WF le a n) : s.toHeap.WF le 0

name: Heap.WF.deleteMin
statement:
theorem Heap.WF.deleteMin {s : Heap α}
    (h : s.WF le n) (eq : s.deleteMin le = some (a, s')) : s'.WF le 0
proof:
:= by
  cases s with cases eq | cons r a c s => ?_
  have : (s.findMin le (cons r a c) ⟨id, a, c, s⟩).WF le :=
    let ⟨_, h₂, h₃⟩ := h
    h₃.findMin ⟨_, fun h => h.of_le (Nat.zero_le _), h₂, h₃⟩
      fun h => ⟨Nat.zero_le _, h₂, h⟩
  revert this
  let { before, val, node, next } := s.findMin le (cons r a c) ⟨id, a, c, s⟩
  intro ⟨_, hk, ih₁, ih₂⟩
  exact ih₁.toHeap.merge <| hk (ih₂.of_le (Nat.le_succ _))

name: Heap.WF.tail
statement: theorem Heap.WF.tail? (hwf : (s : Heap α).WF le n) : s.tail? le = some tl → tl.WF le 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail?]; intro eq
  match eq₂ : s.deleteMin le, eq with
  | some (a, tl), rfl => exact hwf.deleteMin eq₂

name: Heap.WF.tail
statement: theorem Heap.WF.tail (hwf : (s : Heap α).WF le n) : (s.tail le).WF le 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Heap.tail]
  match eq : s.tail? le with
  | none => exact Heap.WF.nil
  | some tl => exact hwf.tail? eq

name: toList_empty

name: toList_singleton

name: toList_append

name: not_isLower_of_isUpper
statement: theorem not_isLower_of_isUpper {c : Char} : c.isUpper → ¬ c.isLower

name: not_isUpper_of_isLower
statement: theorem not_isUpper_of_isLower {c : Char} : c.isLower → ¬ c.isUpper

name: toLower_eq_of_not_isUpper
statement: theorem toLower_eq_of_not_isUpper {c : Char} (h : ¬ c.isUpper) : c.toLower = c

name: toLower_eq_of_isUpper
statement: theorem toLower_eq_of_isUpper {c : Char} (h : c.isUpper) : c.toLower = ofNat (c.toNat + 32)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [val_ofNat, UInt32.ofNat_add]
  · simp_all [isUpper, toLower]
  · simp [isUpper, UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le] at h; grind

name: toUpper_eq_of_not_isLower
statement: theorem toUpper_eq_of_not_isLower {c : Char} (h : ¬ c.isLower) : c.toUpper = c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isLower, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  simp only [toUpper, dite_eq_right h]

name: toUpper_eq_of_isLower
statement: theorem toUpper_eq_of_isLower {c : Char} (h : c.isLower) : c.toUpper = ofNat (c.toNat - 32)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [val_ofNat, UInt32.ofNat_sub]
  · simp_all [toUpper, isLower]; grind
  · simp [isLower, UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le] at h; grind
  · simp [isLower, UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le] at h; grind

name: isUpper_toLower_eq_false
statement: @[simp] theorem isUpper_toLower_eq_false (c : Char) : c.toLower.isUpper = false
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isUpper, toLower]
  split <;> grind [UInt32.toNat_add, toNat_val]

name: isLower_toUpper_eq_false
statement: @[simp] theorem isLower_toUpper_eq_false (c : Char) : c.toUpper.isLower = false
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isLower, toUpper]
  split <;> grind [UInt32.toNat_add, toNat_val]

name: isLower_toLower_eq_isAlpha
statement: @[simp] theorem isLower_toLower_eq_isAlpha (c : Char) : c.toLower.isLower = c.isAlpha
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff]
  by_cases h : c.isUpper
  · simp only [isLower, h, toLower_eq_of_isUpper, ↓Char.isValue, Char.reduceVal, ge_iff_le,
      UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le, UInt32.reduceToNat, toNat_val, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
      isAlpha, Bool.true_or, iff_true]
    simp only [isUpper, ↓Char.isValue, Char.reduceVal, ge_iff_le, UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le,
      UInt32.reduceToNat, toNat_val, Bool.decide_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    have : (c.toNat + 32).isValidChar := by omega
    simp [toNat_ofNat, *]
  · simp [toLower_eq_of_not_isUpper, isAlpha, h]

name: isUpper_toUpper_eq_isAlpha
statement: @[simp] theorem isUpper_toUpper_eq_isAlpha (c : Char) : c.toUpper.isUpper = c.isAlpha
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff]
  by_cases h : c.isLower
  · simp only [isUpper, h, toUpper_eq_of_isLower, ↓Char.isValue, Char.reduceVal, ge_iff_le,
      UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le, UInt32.reduceToNat, toNat_val, Bool.decide_and, Bool.and_eq_true,
      decide_eq_true_eq, isAlpha, Bool.or_true, iff_true]
    simp only [isLower, ↓Char.isValue, Char.reduceVal, ge_iff_le, UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le,
      UInt32.reduceToNat, toNat_val, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    have : (c.toNat - 32).isValidChar := by omega
    have : 32 ≤ c.toNat := by omega
    simp [toNat_ofNat, Nat.le_sub_iff_add_le, *]
  · simp [toUpper_eq_of_not_isLower, isAlpha, h]

name: isAlpha_toLower_eq_isAlpha
statement: @[simp] theorem isAlpha_toLower_eq_isAlpha (c : Char) : c.toLower.isAlpha = c.isAlpha

name: isAlpha_toUpper_eq_isAlpha
statement: @[simp] theorem isAlpha_toUpper_eq_isAlpha (c : Char) : c.toUpper.isAlpha = c.isAlpha

name: toLower_toLower_eq_toLower
statement: @[simp] theorem toLower_toLower_eq_toLower (c : Char) : c.toLower.toLower = c.toLower

name: toLower_toUpper_eq_toLower
statement: @[simp] theorem toLower_toUpper_eq_toLower (c : Char) : c.toUpper.toLower = c.toLower
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hl : c.isLower
  · have hu : ¬ c.isUpper := not_isUpper_of_isLower hl
    have hu' : c.toUpper.isUpper := by simp [isAlpha, hl]
    have hv : (c.toNat - 32).isValidChar := by
      simp only [isLower, isUpper, UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le, toNat_val] at hl hu
      grind
    have h : 32 ≤ c.toNat := by
      simp only [isLower, ↓Char.isValue, Char.reduceVal, ge_iff_le, UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le,
        UInt32.reduceToNat, toNat_val, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, isUpper,
        Bool.decide_and, not_and, Nat.not_le] at hl hu
      omega
    rw [toLower_eq_of_isUpper hu', toUpper_eq_of_isLower hl, toLower_eq_of_not_isUpper hu,
      toNat_ofNat, ite_eq_left hv, Nat.sub_add_cancel h, ofNat_toNat]
  · rw [toUpper_eq_of_not_isLower hl]

name: toUpper_toUpper_eq_toUpper
statement: @[simp] theorem toUpper_toUpper_eq_toUpper (c : Char) : c.toUpper.toUpper = c.toUpper

name: toUpper_toLower_eq_toUpper
statement: @[simp] theorem toUpper_toLower_eq_toUpper (c : Char) : c.toLower.toUpper = c.toUpper
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : c.isUpper
  · have hl : ¬ c.isLower := not_isLower_of_isUpper hu
    have hl' : c.toLower.isLower := by simp [isAlpha, hu]
    have hv : (c.toNat + 32).isValidChar := by
      simp only [isUpper, ↓Char.isValue, Char.reduceVal, ge_iff_le, UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le,
        UInt32.reduceToNat, toNat_val, Bool.decide_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
        isLower, not_and, Nat.not_le] at hu hl
      omega
    rw [toUpper_eq_of_isLower hl', toLower_eq_of_isUpper hu, toUpper_eq_of_not_isLower hl,
      toNat_ofNat, ite_eq_left hv, Nat.add_sub_cancel, ofNat_toNat]
  · rw [toLower_eq_of_not_isUpper hu]

name: beqCaseInsensitiveAsciiOnly.eqv
statement: theorem beqCaseInsensitiveAsciiOnly.eqv : Equivalence (beqCaseInsensitiveAsciiOnly · ·)

statement: theorem le_antisymm_iff {x y : Char} : x = y ↔ x ≤ y ∧ y ≤ x

name: toNat_le_max
statement: @[grind .] theorem toNat_le_max (c : Char) : c.toNat ≤ Char.max
proof:
:= by
  match c.valid with
  | .inl h => simp only [toNat_val] at h; grind
  | .inr ⟨_, h⟩ => simp only [toNat_val] at h; grind

name: toNat_not_surrogate
statement:
@[grind .] theorem toNat_not_surrogate (c : Char) :
    ¬(Char.minSurrogate ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ Char.maxSurrogate)
proof:
:= by
  match c.valid with
  | .inl h => simp only [toNat_val] at h; grind
  | .inr ⟨h, _⟩ => simp only [toNat_val] at h; grind

name: of_all_eq_true_aux
statement:
private theorem of_all_eq_true_aux (h : Char.all p) (n : Nat) (hn : n.isValidChar) :
    p (.ofNatAux n hn)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Char.all, Nat.all_eq_finRange_all, List.all_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
  match hn with
  | .inl hn =>
    have := h.1 ⟨n, by grind⟩
    grind
  | .inr ⟨hn, hn'⟩ =>
    have := h.2 ⟨n - (Char.maxSurrogate + 1), by rw [Char.maxSurrogate, Char.max]; grind⟩
    grind

name: eq_true_of_all_eq_true
statement: theorem eq_true_of_all_eq_true (h : Char.all p) (c : Char) : p c
proof:
:= by
  have : c.toNat.isValidChar := c.valid
  rw [← c.ofNat_toNat, ofNat, dite_eq_left this]
  exact of_all_eq_true_aux h c.toNat this

name: exists_eq_false_of_all_eq_false
statement:
theorem exists_eq_false_of_all_eq_false (h : Char.all p = false) :
    ∃ c, p c = false
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Char.all, Nat.all_eq_finRange_all, List.all_eq_false, Bool.and_eq_false_iff] at h
  simp only [Bool.eq_false_iff]
  match h with
  | .inl ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, _, h⟩ => exact ⟨Char.ofNatAux n (.inl hn), h⟩
  | .inr ⟨⟨n, _⟩, _, h⟩ => exact ⟨Char.ofNatAux (n + (Char.maxSurrogate + 1)) (.inr (by grind)), h⟩

name: all_eq_true_iff_forall_eq_true
statement: theorem all_eq_true_iff_forall_eq_true : Char.all p = true ↔ ∀ c, p c = true
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact eq_true_of_all_eq_true
  · intro h
    cases heq : Char.all p
    · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_eq_false_of_all_eq_false heq
      simp [h c] at hc
    · trivial

name: exists_eq_true_of_any_eq_true
statement: theorem exists_eq_true_of_any_eq_true (h : Char.any p = true) : ∃ c, p c = true
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Char.any, Nat.any_eq_finRange_any, List.any_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true] at h
  match h with
  | .inl ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, _, h⟩ => exact ⟨Char.ofNatAux n (.inl hn), h⟩
  | .inr ⟨⟨n, _⟩, _, h⟩ => exact ⟨Char.ofNatAux (n + Char.maxSurrogate + 1) (.inr (by grind)), h⟩

name: of_any_eq_false_aux
statement:
private theorem of_any_eq_false_aux (h : Char.any p = false) (n : Nat) (hn : n.isValidChar) :
    p (.ofNatAux n hn) = false
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Char.any, Nat.any_eq_finRange_any, List.any_eq_false, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h
  match hn with
  | .inl hn =>
    have := h.1 ⟨n, hn⟩ (List.mem_finRange _)
    grind
  | .inr ⟨hn, hn'⟩ =>
    have := h.2 ⟨n - (Char.maxSurrogate + 1), by rw [Char.maxSurrogate, Char.max]; grind⟩
      (List.mem_finRange _)
    grind

name: eq_false_of_any_eq_false
statement: theorem eq_false_of_any_eq_false (h : Char.any p = false) (c : Char) : p c = false
proof:
:= by
  have : c.toNat.isValidChar := c.valid
  rw [← c.ofNat_toNat, ofNat, dite_eq_left this]
  exact of_any_eq_false_aux h c.toNat this

name: any_eq_true_iff_exists_eq_true
statement: theorem any_eq_true_iff_exists_eq_true : Char.any p = true ↔ ∃ c, p c = true
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_eq_true_of_any_eq_true
  · intro h
    cases heq : Char.any p
    · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
      simp [eq_false_of_any_eq_false heq] at hc
    · trivial

name: foldl_assoc
statement:
theorem foldl_assoc {op : α → α → α} [ha : Std.Associative op] {f : Fin n → α} {a₁ a₂} :
    foldl n (fun x i => op x (f i)) (op a₁ a₂) = op a₁ (foldl n (fun x i => op x (f i)) a₂)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing a₂ with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp only [foldl_succ, ha.assoc, ih]

name: foldr_assoc
statement:
theorem foldr_assoc {op : α → α → α} [ha : Std.Associative op] {f : Fin n → α} {a₁ a₂} :
    foldr n (fun i x => op (f i) x) (op a₁ a₂) = op (foldr n (fun i x => op (f i) x) a₁) a₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Fin.foldl_rev]
  haveI : Std.Associative (flip op) := ⟨fun a b c => (ha.assoc c b a).symm⟩
  exact foldl_assoc (op := flip op)

name: coe_clamp
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_clamp (n m : Nat) : (clamp n m : Nat) = min n m

name: sum_zero

theorem sum_succ [Zero α] [Add α] (x : Fin (n + 1) → α) :

name: prod_succ

name: prod_eq_prod_map_finRange
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem prod_eq_prod_map_finRange [One α] [Mul α] (x : Fin n → α) :

:= by

name: countP_zero
statement: @[simp, grind =] theorem countP_zero (p : Fin 0 → Bool) : Fin.countP p = 0

name: countP_one
statement: @[simp, grind =] theorem countP_one (p : Fin 1 → Bool) : Fin.countP p = (p 0).toNat

name: countP_succ
statement:
theorem countP_succ (p : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) :
    Fin.countP p = (p 0).toNat + Fin.countP (p ·.succ)

name: countP_eq_countP_map_finRange
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem countP_eq_countP_map_finRange (x : Fin n → Bool) :
    Fin.countP x = (List.finRange n).countP x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp +arith [countP_succ, List.finRange_succ, List.countP_cons, List.countP_map,
      Bool.cond_eq_ite, Bool.toNat, ih]; rfl

name: countP_le
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem countP_le (p : Fin n → Bool) : Fin.countP p ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with simp only [countP_zero, countP_succ, Nat.le_refl]
  | succ _ ih =>
    rw [Nat.add_comm]
    apply Nat.add_le_add
    · exact ih ..
    · exact Bool.toNat_le ..

name: findSome

name: findSome
statement: @[simp] theorem findSome?_one {f : Fin 1 → Option α} : findSome? f = f 0

name: findSome
statement:
theorem findSome?_succ {f : Fin (n+1) → Option α} :
    findSome? f = (f 0).or (findSome? (f ·.succ))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [findSome?, foldl_succ, Option.orElse_eq_orElse, Option.orElse_eq_or]
  exact Eq.trans (by cases (f 0) <;> rfl) foldl_assoc

name: findSome
statement:
theorem findSome?_succ_of_some {f : Fin (n+1) → Option α} (h : f 0 = some x) :

statement:

name: findSome
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem findSome?_eq_some_iff {f : Fin n → Option α} :
    findSome? f = some a ↔ ∃ i, f i = some a ∧ ∀ j < i, f j = none
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [findSome?_zero, reduceCtorEq, forall_fin_zero, and_true, exists_fin_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [findSome?_succ, Option.or_eq_some_iff, exists_fin_succ, forall_fin_succ,
      succ_lt_succ_iff, succ_pos, not_lt_zero, ih]
    grind

name: findSome
statement:
@[simp, grind =] theorem findSome?_eq_none_iff {f : Fin n → Option α} :

proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [findSome?_zero, forall_fin_zero]
  | succ n ih => simp only [findSome?_succ, Option.or_eq_none_iff, ih, forall_fin_succ]

name: isNone_findSome

theorem isNone_findSome?_iff {f : Fin n → Option α} :

name: isSome_findSome
statement:
@[simp] theorem isSome_findSome?_iff {f : Fin n → Option α} :

:= by

name: exists_minimal_of_findSome

name: exists_eq_some_of_findSome

theorem exists_eq_some_of_findSome?_eq_some {f : Fin n → Option α}

  induction n with
  | zero => absurd x.is_lt; simp

    simp only [decodeSigma]
    split

    · next h1 =>
      have h2 : x - f 0 < Fin.sum (f ·.succ) := by grind [sum_succ]
      have : encodeSigma (f ·.succ) (decodeSigma (f ·.succ) ⟨x - f 0, h2⟩) = ↑x - f 0 := by
        rw [ih]
      ext; simp only [encodeSigma]
      conv => rhs; rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_gt h1)]
      congr

name: decodeSigma_encodeSigma
statement:
@[simp] theorem decodeSigma_encodeSigma (f : Fin n → Nat) (x : (i : Fin n) × Fin (f i)) :
    decodeSigma f (encodeSigma f x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => nomatch x
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [decodeSigma]
    match x with
    | ⟨⟨0, _⟩, x, hx⟩ =>
      split
      · rfl
      · contradiction
    | ⟨⟨i+1, hi⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩ =>
      have : ¬ encodeSigma f ⟨⟨i+1, hi⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩ < f 0 := by simp [encodeSigma]
      rw [dite_eq_right this]
      have : (encodeSigma f ⟨⟨i+1, hi⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩).1 - f 0 =
          (encodeSigma (f ·.succ) ⟨⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩).1 := by
        simp [encodeSigma, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
      have h := ih (f ·.succ) ⟨⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
      simp [Sigma.ext_iff, Fin.ext_iff] at h ⊢
      constructor
      · conv => rhs; rw [← h.1]
        apply congrArg
        apply congrArg Sigma.fst
        congr
      · apply HEq.trans _ h.2; congr

name: encodeFun_decodeFun
statement: @[simp] theorem encodeFun_decodeFun (x : Fin (n ^ m)) : encodeFun (decodeFun x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction m with simp only [encodeFun, decodeFun, Fin.succ]
  | zero => grind
  | succ m ih => cases x; simp [ih]; rw [← Fin.zero_eta, Nat.div_add_mod]

name: decodeFun_encodeFun
statement: @[simp] theorem decodeFun_encodeFun (x : Fin m → Fin n) : decodeFun (encodeFun x) = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i; induction m with simp only [encodeFun, decodeFun]
  | zero => nomatch i
  | succ m ih =>
    have hn : 0 < n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (x 0).is_lt
    split
    · ext; simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
    · next i hi =>
      have : decodeFun (encodeFun fun k => x k.succ) ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩
          = x ⟨i+1, hi⟩ := by rw [ih]; rfl
      simp [← this, Nat.mul_add_div hn, Nat.div_eq_of_lt]

name: encodePi_decodePi
statement:
@[simp] theorem encodePi_decodePi (f : Fin n → Nat) (x : Fin (Fin.prod f)) :
    encodePi f (decodePi f x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    match x with
    | ⟨0, _⟩ => rfl
    | ⟨_+1, h⟩ => simp at h
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [encodePi, decodePi, ih]
    ext
    conv => rhs; rw [← Nat.div_add_mod x (f 0)]
    congr

name: decodePi_encodePi
statement:
@[simp] theorem decodePi_encodePi (f : Fin n → Nat) (x : (i : Fin n) → Fin (f i)) :
    decodePi f (encodePi f x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => funext i; nomatch i
  | succ n ih =>
    have h0 : 0 < f 0 := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (x 0).is_lt
    funext i
    simp only [decodePi]
    split
    · simp [encodePi, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (x 0).is_lt]
    · next i hi =>
      have h : decodePi (f ·.succ) (encodePi (f ·.succ) fun i => x i.succ)
          ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩ = x ⟨i+1, hi⟩ := by simp [ih (f ·.succ)]; done
      conv => rhs; rw [← h]
      congr; simp [encodePi, Nat.mul_add_div h0, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (x 0).is_lt]; rfl

name: encodeSubtype_zero_pos
statement:
theorem encodeSubtype_zero_pos {P : Fin (n+1) → Prop} [DecidablePred P] (h₀ : P 0) :
    encodeSubtype P ⟨0, h₀⟩ = ⟨0, by grind [countP_succ]⟩

name: encodeSubtype_succ_pos
encodeSubtype_succ_neg
statement:
theorem encodeSubtype_succ_neg {P : Fin (n+1) → Prop} [DecidablePred P] (h₀ : ¬ P 0) {i : Fin n}
    (h : P i.succ) : encodeSubtype P ⟨i.succ, h⟩ =
      (encodeSubtype (fun i => P i.succ) ⟨i, h⟩).cast
        (by simp [-countP_eq_countP_map_finRange, countP_succ, *])

name: encodeSubtype_decodeSubtype
statement:
@[simp] theorem encodeSubtype_decodeSubtype (P : Fin n → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (x : Fin (Fin.countP (P ·))) : encodeSubtype P (decodeSubtype P x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => absurd x.is_lt; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [decodeSubtype]
    split
    · ext; split <;> simp [encodeSubtype_zero_pos, encodeSubtype, *]; done
    · ext; simp [encodeSubtype, *]

name: decodeSubtype_encodeSubtype
statement:
@[simp] theorem decodeSubtype_encodeSubtype (P : Fin n → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (x : { x // P x}) :
    decodeSubtype P (encodeSubtype P x) = x
proof:
:= by
  match x with
  | ⟨i, h⟩ =>
    induction n with
    | zero => absurd x.val.is_lt; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      if h₀ : P 0 then
        simp only [decodeSubtype, dite_eq_left h₀]
        cases i using Fin.cases with
        | zero => rw [encodeSubtype_zero_pos h₀]
        | succ i =>
          rw [encodeSubtype_succ_pos h₀]
          simp only [val_cast, val_succ, Fin.eta, Subtype.mk.injEq]
          congr
          rw [ih (fun i => P i.succ) ⟨i, h⟩]
      else
        simp only [decodeSubtype, dite_eq_right h₀]
        cases i using Fin.cases with
        | zero => contradiction
        | succ i =>
          rw [encodeSubtype_succ_neg h₀]
          simp only [val_cast, Fin.eta, Subtype.mk.injEq]
          congr
          rw [ih (fun i => P i.succ) ⟨i, h⟩]

name: equiv_getRepr
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_getRepr (s : Setoid (Fin n)) [DecidableRel s.r] (x : Fin n) :
    s.r x (getRepr s x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [getRepr]
  split
  · next hsome =>
    apply of_decide_eq_true
    apply eq_true_of_find?_eq_some hsome
  · next hnone =>
    absurd s.refl x
    apply of_decide_eq_false
    apply eq_false_of_find?_eq_none hnone

name: getRepr_equiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem getRepr_equiv (s : Setoid (Fin n)) [DecidableRel s.r] (x : Fin n) :
    s.r (getRepr s x) x

name: getRepr_eq_getRepr_of_equiv
statement:
theorem getRepr_eq_getRepr_of_equiv (s : Setoid (Fin n)) [DecidableRel s.r] (h : s.r x y) :
    getRepr s x = getRepr s y
proof:
:= by
  have hfind : Fin.find? (s.r x ·) = Fin.find? (s.r y ·) := by
    congr
    funext z
    rw [decide_eq_decide]
    constructor
    · exact Setoid.trans (Setoid.symm h)
    · exact Setoid.trans h
  simp only [getRepr]
  split
  · next hx =>
    rw [hfind] at hx
    split
    · next hy =>
      rwa [hx, Option.some_inj] at hy
    · next hy =>
      rw [hx] at hy
      contradiction
  · next hx =>
    rw [hfind] at hx
    split
    · next hy =>
      rw [hx] at hy
      contradiction
    · rfl

name: getRepr_getRepr
statement:
@[simp] theorem getRepr_getRepr (s : Setoid (Fin n)) [DecidableRel s.r] (x : Fin n) :
    getRepr s (getRepr s x) = getRepr s x

name: encodeQuotient_decodeQuotient
statement:
@[simp] theorem encodeQuotient_decodeQuotient (s : Setoid (Fin n)) [DecidableRel s.r] (x) :
    encodeQuotient s (decodeQuotient s x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [decodeQuotient, encodeQuotient, Quotient.liftOn, Quotient.mk, Quot.liftOn]
  conv => rhs; rw [← encodeSubtype_decodeSubtype _ x]
  congr
  exact (decodeSubtype _ x).property

name: decodeQuotient_encodeQuotient
statement:
@[simp] theorem decodeQuotient_encodeQuotient (s : Setoid (Fin n)) [DecidableRel s.r] (x) :
    decodeQuotient s (encodeQuotient s x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | _ x =>
    simp only [decodeQuotient, encodeQuotient, Quotient.liftOn, Quotient.mk, Quot.liftOn]
    apply Quot.sound
    simp

name: val_ofBits
statement: @[simp] theorem val_ofBits (f : Fin n → Bool) : (ofBits f).val = Nat.ofBits f

name: dfoldrM_loop_zero
statement:
theorem dfoldrM_loop_zero [Monad m] (f : (i : Fin n) → α i.succ → m (α i.castSucc)) (x) :
    dfoldrM.loop n α f 0 h x = pure x

name: dfoldrM_loop_succ
statement:
theorem dfoldrM_loop_succ [Monad m] (f : (i : Fin n) → α i.succ → m (α i.castSucc)) (x) :
    dfoldrM.loop n α f (i+1) h x = f ⟨i, by omega⟩ x >>= dfoldrM.loop n α f i (by omega)

name: dfoldrM_loop
statement:
theorem dfoldrM_loop [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (f : (i : Fin (n+1)) → α i.succ → m (α i.castSucc))
    (x) : dfoldrM.loop (n+1) α f (i+1) h x =
      dfoldrM.loop n (α ∘ succ) (f ·.succ) i (by omega) x >>= f 0
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    rw [dfoldrM_loop_zero, dfoldrM_loop_succ, pure_bind]
    conv => rhs; rw [← bind_pure (f 0 x)]
    rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [dfoldrM_loop_succ, dfoldrM_loop_succ, bind_assoc]
    congr; funext; exact ih ..

name: dfoldrM_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem dfoldrM_zero [Monad m] (f : (i : Fin 0) → α i.succ → m (α i.castSucc)) (x) :
    dfoldrM 0 α f x = pure x

name: dfoldrM_succ
statement:
theorem dfoldrM_succ [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (f : (i : Fin (n+1)) → α i.succ → m (α i.castSucc))
    (x) : dfoldrM (n+1) α f x = dfoldrM n (α ∘ succ) (f ·.succ) x >>= f 0

name: dfoldrM_eq_foldrM
statement:
theorem dfoldrM_eq_foldrM [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (f : (i : Fin n) → α → m α) (x) :
    dfoldrM n (fun _ => α) f x = foldrM n f x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [dfoldrM_zero, foldrM_zero]
  | succ n ih => simp only [dfoldrM_succ, foldrM_succ, Function.comp_def, ih]

name: dfoldr_eq_dfoldrM
statement:
theorem dfoldr_eq_dfoldrM (f : (i : Fin n) → α i.succ → α i.castSucc) (x) :
    dfoldr n α f x = dfoldrM (m:=Id) n α f x

name: dfoldr_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem dfoldr_zero (f : (i : Fin 0) → α i.succ → α i.castSucc) (x) :
    dfoldr 0 α f x = x

name: dfoldr_succ
statement:
theorem dfoldr_succ (f : (i : Fin (n+1)) → α i.succ → α i.castSucc) (x) :
    dfoldr (n+1) α f x = f 0 (dfoldr n (α ∘ succ) (f ·.succ) x)

name: dfoldr_succ_last
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [dfoldr_succ, dfoldr_zero, last, zero_eta]
  | succ n ih => rw [dfoldr_succ, ih (α := α ∘ succ) (f ·.succ), dfoldr_succ]; congr

name: dfoldr_eq_foldr
statement:
theorem dfoldr_eq_foldr (f : (i : Fin n) → α → α) (x) :
    dfoldr n (fun _ => α) f x = foldr n f x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [dfoldr_zero, foldr_zero]
  | succ n ih => simp only [dfoldr_succ, foldr_succ, Function.comp_def, ih]

name: dfoldlM_loop_lt
statement:
theorem dfoldlM_loop_lt [Monad m] (f : ∀ (i : Fin n), α i.castSucc → m (α i.succ)) (h : i < n) (x) :
    dfoldlM.loop n α f i (Nat.lt_add_right 1 h) x =
      (f ⟨i, h⟩ x) >>= (dfoldlM.loop n α f (i+1) (Nat.add_lt_add_right h 1))

name: dfoldlM_loop_eq
statement:
theorem dfoldlM_loop_eq [Monad m] (f : ∀ (i : Fin n), α i.castSucc → m (α i.succ)) (x) :
    dfoldlM.loop n α f n (Nat.le_refl _) x = pure x

name: dfoldlM_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem dfoldlM_zero [Monad m] (f : (i : Fin 0) → α i.castSucc → m (α i.succ)) (x) :
    dfoldlM 0 α f x = pure x

name: dfoldlM_loop
statement:
theorem dfoldlM_loop [Monad m] (f : (i : Fin (n+1)) → α i.castSucc → m (α i.succ)) (h : i < n+1)
    (x) : dfoldlM.loop (n+1) α f i (Nat.lt_add_right 1 h) x =
      f ⟨i, h⟩ x >>= (dfoldlM.loop n (α ∘ succ) (f ·.succ ·) i h .)
proof:
:= by
  if h' : i < n then
    rw [dfoldlM_loop_lt _ h _]
    congr; funext
    rw [dfoldlM_loop_lt _ h' _, dfoldlM_loop]; rfl
  else
    cases Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h) (Nat.not_lt.1 h')
    rw [dfoldlM_loop_lt _ h]
    congr; funext
    rw [dfoldlM_loop_eq, dfoldlM_loop_eq]

name: dfoldlM_succ
statement:
theorem dfoldlM_succ [Monad m] (f : (i : Fin (n+1)) → α i.castSucc → m (α i.succ)) (x) :
    dfoldlM (n+1) α f x = f 0 x >>= (dfoldlM n (α ∘ succ) (f ·.succ ·) .)

name: dfoldlM_eq_foldlM
statement:
theorem dfoldlM_eq_foldlM [Monad m] (f : (i : Fin n) → α → m α) (x : α) :
    dfoldlM n (fun _ => α) f x = foldlM n (fun x i => f i x) x
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp only [dfoldlM_zero, foldlM_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [dfoldlM_succ, foldlM_succ, Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_def]
    congr; ext; simp only [ih]

name: dfoldl_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem dfoldl_zero (f : (i : Fin 0) → α i.castSucc → α i.succ) (x) :
    dfoldl 0 α f x = x

name: dfoldl_succ
statement:
theorem dfoldl_succ (f : (i : Fin (n+1)) → α i.castSucc → α i.succ) (x) :
    dfoldl (n+1) α f x = dfoldl n (α ∘ succ) (f ·.succ ·) (f 0 x)

name: dfoldl_succ_last
statement:
theorem dfoldl_succ_last (f : (i : Fin (n+1)) → α i.castSucc → α i.succ) (x) :
    dfoldl (n+1) α f x = f (last n) (dfoldl n (α ∘ castSucc) (f ·.castSucc ·) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dfoldl_succ]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [dfoldl_succ, @ih (α ∘ succ) (f ·.succ ·), dfoldl_succ]; congr

name: dfoldl_eq_dfoldlM
statement:
theorem dfoldl_eq_dfoldlM (f : (i : Fin n) → α i.castSucc → α i.succ) (x) :
    dfoldl n α f x = dfoldlM (m := Id) n α f x

name: dfoldl_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem dfoldl_eq_foldl (f : Fin n → α → α) (x : α) :
    dfoldl n (fun _ => α) f x = foldl n (fun x i => f i x) x
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp only [dfoldl_zero, foldl_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [dfoldl_succ, foldl_succ, Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_def]
    congr; simp only [ih]

statement:

proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => rw [foldl_zero, List.finRange_zero, List.foldl_nil]
  | succ n ih => rw [foldl_succ, ih, List.finRange_succ, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_map]

  | zero => rw [foldr_zero, List.finRange_zero, List.foldr_nil]
  | succ n ih => rw [foldr_succ, ih, List.finRange_succ, List.foldr_cons, List.foldr_map]

name: scanlM.loop_toList
statement:
theorem scanlM.loop_toList [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    {f : β → α → m β} {stop : Nat} (h : stop ≤ as.size) :
    Array.toList <$> scanlM.loop f init as start stop h acc =
      return acc.toList
               ++ (← as.toList.drop start
                  |>.take (stop - start)
                  |>.scanlM f init)
proof:
:= by
  induction h_ind : stop - start generalizing start acc init with
  | zero =>
    unfold scanlM.loop
    simp [show ¬(start < stop) by omega, ← Array.toList_push]
  | succ n ih =>
    unfold scanlM.loop
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by simp; omega)]
    simp [show start < stop by omega, show stop - (start + 1) = n by omega, ih]

name: scanlM_eq_scanlM_toList
statement:
theorem scanlM_eq_scanlM_toList [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : β → α → m β} {as : Array α} :
    as.scanlM f init = List.toArray <$> as.toList.scanlM f init

name: toList_scanlM
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem toList_scanlM [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : β → α → m β} {as : Array α} :
    toList <$> as.scanlM f init = as.toList.scanlM f init

name: scanrM.loop_toList
statement:
theorem scanrM.loop_toList [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : α → β → m β}
    {start : Nat} {h : start ≤ as.size} :
    Array.toList <$> scanrM.loop f init as start stop h acc =
      return (← as.toList.drop stop
                  |>.take (start - stop)
                  |>.scanrM f init)
                ++ acc.toList.reverse
proof:
:= by
  induction h_ind : start - stop generalizing stop acc init start with
  | zero =>
    simp [scanrM.loop, show ¬ stop < start by omega]
  | succ n ih =>
    unfold scanrM.loop
    simp_all only [bind_pure_comp, show stop < start by omega, ↓reduceDIte]
    simp only [map_bind]
    conv =>
      lhs
      arg 2
      ext a
      rw [ih (start := start - 1) (stop := stop) (acc := acc.push init) (by omega)]
    simp only [List.scanrM_eq_scanlM_reverse]
    have h_take := List.take_succ_drop (l := as.toList) (n := n) (stop := stop) (by simp; omega)
    simp only [h_take, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_singleton, List.singleton_append,
      List.scanlM_cons, map_bind, show stop + n = start - 1 by omega]
    apply bind_congr

name: scanlM_loop_eq_scanlMFast_loop
statement:
private theorem scanlM_loop_eq_scanlMFast_loop [Monad m]
    {f : β → α → m β} {init : β} {as : Array α} {h_size : as.SizeFitsUSize}
    {start stop : Nat} {h_start : start ≤ as.size}
    {h_stop : stop ≤ as.size} {acc : Array β} :
    scanlM.loop f init as start stop h_stop acc
      = scanlMFast.loop f init as (USize.ofNat start) (USize.ofNat stop)
      (by rw [USize.toNat_ofNat_of_le_of_lt h_size h_stop]; exact h_stop) acc
proof:
:= by
  generalize h_n : stop - start = n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing start acc init
  rename_i n ih
  rw [scanlM.loop, scanlMFast.loop]
  have h_stop_usize := USize.toNat_ofNat_of_le_of_lt h_size h_stop
  have h_start_usize := USize.toNat_ofNat_of_le_of_lt h_size h_start
  split
  case isTrue h_lt =>
    simp_all only [USize.toNat_ofNat', ↓reduceDIte, uget,
      show USize.ofNat start < USize.ofNat stop by simp_all [USize.lt_iff_toNat_lt]]
    apply bind_congr
    intro next
    have h_start_succ : USize.ofNat start + 1 = USize.ofNat (start + 1) := by
      simp_all only [← USize.toNat_inj, USize.toNat_add]
      grind only [USize.size_eq, USize.toNat_ofNat_of_le_of_lt]
    rw [h_start_succ]
    apply ih (stop - (start + 1)) <;> omega
  case isFalse h_nlt => grind [USize.lt_iff_toNat_lt]

    {f : β → α → m β} {init : β} {as : Array α}
    {h_size : as.SizeFitsUSize} {start stop : Nat} :
    scanlM f init as start stop = scanlMFast f init as start stop
proof:
:= by
  unfold scanlM scanlMFast
  apply scanlM_loop_eq_scanlMFast_loop
  simp_all only [gt_iff_lt]
  apply Nat.min_le_right
