theorem parentD_linkAux {self} {x y : Fin self.size} :
    parentD (linkAux self x y) i =
    if x.1 = y then
      parentD self i
    else
      if self[y.1].rank < self[x.1].rank then
        if y = i then x else parentD self i
      else
        if x = i then y else parentD self i
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [linkAux]; split <;> [rfl; split] <;> [rw [parentD_set]; split] <;> rw [parentD_set]
  split <;> [(subst i; rwa [ite_eq_right, parentD_eq]); rw [parentD_set]]

name: parent_link
statement:
theorem parent_link {self} {x y : Fin self.size} (yroot) {i} :
    (link self x y yroot).parent i =
    if x.1 = y then
      self.parent i
    else
      if self.rank y < self.rank x then
        if y = i then x else self.parent i
      else
        if x = i then y else self.parent i

name: root_link
statement:
theorem root_link {self : UnionFind} {x y : Fin self.size}
    (xroot : self.parent x = x) (yroot : self.parent y = y) :
    ∃ r, (r = x ∨ r = y) ∧ ∀ i,
      (link self x y yroot).rootD i =
      if self.rootD i = x ∨ self.rootD i = y then r.1 else self.rootD i
proof:
:= by
  if h : x.1 = y then
    refine ⟨x, .inl rfl, fun i => ?_⟩
    rw [rootD_ext (m2 := self) (fun _ => by rw [parent_link, ite_eq_left h])]
    split <;> [obtain _ | _ := ‹_› <;> simp [*]; rfl]
  else
  have {x y : Fin self.size}
      (xroot : self.parent x = x) (yroot : self.parent y = y) {m : UnionFind}
      (hm : ∀ i, m.parent i = if y = i then x.1 else self.parent i) :
      ∃ r, (r = x ∨ r = y) ∧ ∀ i,
        m.rootD i = if self.rootD i = x ∨ self.rootD i = y then r.1 else self.rootD i := by
    let rec go (i) :
        m.rootD i = if self.rootD i = x ∨ self.rootD i = y then x.1 else self.rootD i := by
      if h : m.parent i = i then
        rw [rootD_eq_self.2 h]; rw [hm i] at h; split at h
        · rw [ite_eq_left, h]; simp [← h, rootD_eq_self, xroot]
        · rw [rootD_eq_self.2 ‹_›]; split <;> [skip; rfl]
          next h' => exact h'.resolve_right (Ne.symm ‹_›)
      else
        have _ := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (m.lt_rankMax i) (m.rank_lt h)
        rw [← rootD_parent, go (m.parent i)]
        rw [hm i]; split <;> [subst i; rw [rootD_parent]]
        simp [rootD_eq_self.2 xroot, rootD_eq_self.2 yroot]
    termination_by m.rankMax - m.rank i
    exact ⟨x, .inl rfl, go⟩
  if hr : self.rank y < self.rank x then
    exact this xroot yroot fun i => by simp [parent_link, h, hr]
  else
    simpa (config := {singlePass := true}) [or_comm] using
      this yroot xroot fun i => by simp [parent_link, h, hr]

name: equiv_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem equiv_empty : Equiv empty a b ↔ a = b

name: equiv_push
statement: @[simp] theorem equiv_push : Equiv self.push a b ↔ Equiv self a b

name: equiv_rootD
statement: @[simp] theorem equiv_rootD : Equiv self (self.rootD a) a

name: equiv_rootD_l
statement: @[simp] theorem equiv_rootD_l : Equiv self (self.rootD a) b ↔ Equiv self a b

name: equiv_rootD_r
statement: @[simp] theorem equiv_rootD_r : Equiv self a (self.rootD b) ↔ Equiv self a b

name: equiv_find
statement: theorem equiv_find : Equiv (self.find x).1 a b ↔ Equiv self a b

name: equiv_link
statement:
theorem equiv_link {self : UnionFind} {x y : Fin self.size}
    (xroot : self.parent x = x) (yroot : self.parent y = y) :
    Equiv (link self x y yroot) a b ↔
    Equiv self a b ∨ Equiv self a x ∧ Equiv self y b ∨ Equiv self a y ∧ Equiv self x b
proof:
:= by
  have {m : UnionFind} {x y : Fin self.size}
      (xroot : self.rootD x = x) (yroot : self.rootD y = y)
      (hm : ∀ i, m.rootD i = if self.rootD i = x ∨ self.rootD i = y then x.1 else self.rootD i) :
      Equiv m a b ↔
      Equiv self a b ∨ Equiv self a x ∧ Equiv self y b ∨ Equiv self a y ∧ Equiv self x b := by
    simp [Equiv, hm, xroot, yroot]
    by_cases h1 : rootD self a = x <;> by_cases h2 : rootD self b = x <;>
      simp [h1, h2, imp_false, Decidable.not_not, -left_eq_ite_iff]
    · simp [Ne.symm h2, -left_eq_ite_iff]; split <;> simp [@eq_comm _ _ (rootD self b), *]
    · by_cases h1 : rootD self a = y <;> by_cases h2 : rootD self b = y <;>
        simp [@eq_comm _ _ (rootD self b), *]
  obtain ⟨r, ha, hr⟩ := root_link xroot yroot; revert hr
  rw [← rootD_eq_self] at xroot yroot
  obtain rfl | rfl := ha
  · exact this xroot yroot
  · simpa [or_comm, and_comm] using this yroot xroot

name: equiv_union
statement:
theorem equiv_union {self : UnionFind} {x y : Fin self.size} :
    Equiv (union self x y) a b ↔
    Equiv self a b ∨ Equiv self a x ∧ Equiv self y b ∨ Equiv self a y ∧ Equiv self x b
proof:
:= by
  simp [union]; rw [equiv_link (by simp [← rootD_eq_self, rootD_rootD])]; simp [equiv_find]

name: parentD_eq
statement:
theorem parentD_eq {arr : Array UFNode} {i} (h) :
    parentD arr i = arr[i].parent

name: rankD_eq
statement: theorem rankD_eq {arr : Array UFNode} {i} (h) : rankD arr i = arr[i].rank

name: parentD_of_not_lt
statement: theorem parentD_of_not_lt : ¬i < arr.size → parentD arr i = i

name: lt_of_parentD
statement: theorem lt_of_parentD : parentD arr i ≠ i → i < arr.size

name: parentD_set
statement:
theorem parentD_set {arr : Array UFNode} {x v i h} :
    parentD (arr.set x v h) i = if x = i then v.parent else parentD arr i
proof:
:= by
  rw [parentD]; simp only [Array.size_set, parentD]
  split
  · split <;> simp_all
  · split <;> [(subst i; cases ‹¬_› h); rfl]

name: rankD_set
statement:
theorem rankD_set {arr : Array UFNode} {x v i h} :
    rankD (arr.set x v h) i = if x = i then v.rank else rankD arr i
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankD]; simp only [Array.size_set, rankD]
  split
  · split <;> simp_all
  · split <;> [(subst i; cases ‹¬_› h); rfl]

name: parent'_lt
statement: theorem parent'_lt (self : UnionFind) (i : Nat) (h) : self.arr[i].parent < self.size

name: parent_lt
statement: theorem parent_lt (self : UnionFind) (i : Nat) : self.parent i < self.size ↔ i < self.size
proof:
:= by
  simp only [parentD]; split <;> simp only [*, parent'_lt]

name: rank_lt
statement:
theorem rank_lt {self : UnionFind} {i : Nat} : self.parent i ≠ i →
    self.rank i < self.rank (self.parent i)

name: rank'_lt
statement:
theorem rank'_lt (self : UnionFind) (i h) : self.arr[i].parent ≠ i →
    self.rank i < self.rank (self.arr[i]).parent
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← parentD_eq] using self.rankD_lt

name: rank'_lt_rankMax
statement: theorem rank'_lt_rankMax (self : UnionFind) (i : Nat) (h) : (self.arr[i]).rank < self.rankMax
proof:
:= by
  let rec go : ∀ {l} {x : UFNode}, x ∈ l → x.rank ≤ List.foldr (max ·.rank) 0 l
    | a::l, _, List.Mem.head _ => by dsimp; apply Nat.le_max_left
    | a::l, _, .tail _ h => by dsimp; exact Nat.le_trans (go h) (Nat.le_max_right ..)
  simp only [rankMax, ← Array.foldr_toList]
  exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.2 <| go (self.arr.toList.getElem_mem _)

name: rankD_lt_rankMax
statement:
theorem rankD_lt_rankMax (self : UnionFind) (i : Nat) :
    rankD self.arr i < self.rankMax
proof:
:= by
  simp [rankD]; split <;> [apply rank'_lt_rankMax; apply Nat.succ_pos]

name: lt_rankMax
statement: theorem lt_rankMax (self : UnionFind) (i : Nat) : self.rank i < self.rankMax

name: push_rankD
statement: theorem push_rankD (arr : Array UFNode) : rankD (arr.push ⟨arr.size, 0⟩) i = rankD arr i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rankD, Array.size_push, Array.getElem_push, dite_eq_ite]
  split <;> split <;> first | simp | cases ‹¬_› (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt ‹_›)

name: push_parentD
statement: theorem push_parentD (arr : Array UFNode) : parentD (arr.push ⟨arr.size, 0⟩) i = parentD arr i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [parentD, Array.size_push, Array.getElem_push, dite_eq_ite]
  split <;> split <;> try simp
  · exact Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.ge_of_not_lt ‹_›) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ ‹_›)
  · cases ‹¬_› (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt ‹_›)

name: parent_root
statement:
@[nolint unusedHavesSuffices]
theorem parent_root (self : UnionFind) (x : Fin self.size) :
    (self.arr[(self.root x).1]).parent = self.root x
proof:
:= by
  rw [root]; split <;> [assumption; skip]
  have := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (self.lt_rankMax x) (self.rank'_lt _ _ ‹_›)
  apply parent_root

name: parent_rootD
statement:
theorem parent_rootD (self : UnionFind) (x : Nat) :
    self.parent (self.rootD x) = self.rootD x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootD]
  split
  · simp [parentD, parent_root]
  · simp [parentD_of_not_lt, *]

name: rootD_parent
statement:
@[nolint unusedHavesSuffices]
theorem rootD_parent (self : UnionFind) (x : Nat) : self.rootD (self.parent x) = self.rootD x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rootD, parent_lt]
  split
  · simp only [parentD, ↓reduceDIte, *]
    (conv => rhs; rw [root]); split
    · rw [root, dite_eq_left] <;> simp_all
    · simp
  · simp only [not_false_eq_true, parentD_of_not_lt, *]

name: rootD_lt
statement: theorem rootD_lt {self : UnionFind} {x : Nat} : self.rootD x < self.size ↔ x < self.size

name: rootD_eq_self
statement:
@[nolint unusedHavesSuffices]
theorem rootD_eq_self {self : UnionFind} {x : Nat} : self.rootD x = x ↔ self.parent x = x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => by rw [← h, parent_rootD], fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [rootD]; split <;> [rw [root, dite_eq_left (by rwa [parent, parentD_eq ‹_›] at h)]; rfl]

name: rootD_rootD
statement: theorem rootD_rootD {self : UnionFind} {x : Nat} : self.rootD (self.rootD x) = self.rootD x

name: rootD_ext
statement:
theorem rootD_ext {m1 m2 : UnionFind}
    (H : ∀ x, m1.parent x = m2.parent x) {x} : m1.rootD x = m2.rootD x
proof:
:= by
  if h : m2.parent x = x then
    rw [rootD_eq_self.2 h, rootD_eq_self.2 ((H _).trans h)]
  else
    have := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (m2.lt_rankMax x) (m2.rank_lt h)
    rw [← rootD_parent, H, rootD_ext H, rootD_parent]

name: le_rank_root
statement: theorem le_rank_root {self : UnionFind} {x : Nat} : self.rank x ≤ self.rank (self.rootD x)
proof:
:= by
  if h : self.parent x = x then
    rw [rootD_eq_self.2 h]; exact Nat.le_refl ..
  else
    have := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (self.lt_rankMax x) (self.rank_lt h)
    rw [← rootD_parent]
    exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt (self.rank_lt h)) le_rank_root

name: lt_rank_root
statement:
theorem lt_rank_root {self : UnionFind} {x : Nat} :
    self.rank x < self.rank (self.rootD x) ↔ self.parent x ≠ x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h h' => Nat.ne_of_lt h (by rw [rootD_eq_self.2 h']), fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [← rootD_parent]
  exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (self.rank_lt h) le_rank_root

name: findAux_root
statement:
@[nolint unusedHavesSuffices]
theorem findAux_root {self : UnionFind} {x : Fin self.size} :
    (findAux self x).root = self.root x
proof:
:= by
  rw [findAux, root]
  simp only [dite_eq_ite]
  split <;> simp only
  have := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (self.lt_rankMax x) (self.rank'_lt _ _ ‹_›)
  exact findAux_root

name: findAux_s
statement:
@[nolint unusedHavesSuffices]
theorem findAux_s {self : UnionFind} {x : Fin self.size} :
    (findAux self x).s = if self.arr[x.1].parent = x then self.arr else
      (self.findAux ⟨_, self.parent'_lt x x.2⟩).s.modify x fun s =>
        { s with parent := self.rootD x }
proof:
:= by
  rw [show self.rootD _ = (self.findAux ⟨_, self.parent'_lt x x.2⟩).root from _]
  · rw [findAux]; split <;> rfl
  · rw [← rootD_parent, parent, parentD_eq (Fin.is_lt _)]
    simp only [rootD, findAux_root]
    apply dite_eq_left

name: rankD_findAux
statement:
theorem rankD_findAux {self : UnionFind} {x : Fin self.size} :
    rankD (findAux self x).s i = self.rank i
proof:
:= by
  if h : i < self.size then
    rw [findAux_s]; split <;> [rfl; skip]
    have := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (self.lt_rankMax x) (self.rank'_lt _ _ ‹_›)
    have := lt_of_parentD (by rwa [parentD_eq])
    rw [rankD_eq (by simp [FindAux.size_eq, h]), Array.getElem_modify]
    split <;>
      simp [← rankD_eq, rankD_findAux (x := ⟨_, self.parent'_lt _ x.2⟩)]
  else
    simp only [rankD, rank]
    rw [dite_eq_right (by rwa [FindAux.size_eq]), dite_eq_right h]

name: parentD_findAux
statement:
theorem parentD_findAux {self : UnionFind} {x : Fin self.size} :
    parentD (findAux self x).s i =
    if i = x then self.rootD x else parentD (self.findAux ⟨_, self.parent'_lt _ x.2⟩).s i
proof:
:= by
  rw [findAux_s]; split <;> [split; skip]
  · subst i; rw [rootD_eq_self.2 _] <;> simp [parentD_eq, *]
  · rw [findAux_s]; simp [*]
  · next h =>
    rw [parentD]; split <;> rename_i h'
    · rw [Array.getElem_modify (by simpa using h')]
      simp only [@eq_comm _ i]
      split <;> simp [← parentD_eq]
    · rw [ite_eq_right (mt (by rintro rfl; simp [FindAux.size_eq]) h')]
      rw [parentD, dite_eq_right]; simpa using h'

name: parentD_findAux_rootD
statement:
theorem parentD_findAux_rootD {self : UnionFind} {x : Fin self.size} :
    parentD (findAux self x).s (self.rootD x) = self.rootD x
proof:
:= by
  rw [parentD_findAux]; split <;> [rfl; rename_i h]
  rw [rootD_eq_self, parent, parentD_eq x.2] at h
  have := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (self.lt_rankMax x) (self.rank'_lt _ _ ‹_›)
  rw [← rootD_parent, parent, parentD_eq x.2]
  exact parentD_findAux_rootD (x := ⟨_, self.parent'_lt _ x.2⟩)

name: parentD_findAux_lt
statement:
theorem parentD_findAux_lt {self : UnionFind} {x : Fin self.size} (h : i < self.size) :
    parentD (findAux self x).s i < self.size
proof:
:= by
  if h' : self.arr[x.1].parent = x then
    rw [findAux_s, ite_eq_left h']; apply self.parentD_lt h
  else
    rw [parentD_findAux]
    split
    · simp [rootD_lt]
    · have := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (self.lt_rankMax x) (self.rank'_lt _ _ ‹_›)
      apply parentD_findAux_lt h

name: parentD_findAux_or
statement:
theorem parentD_findAux_or (self : UnionFind) (x : Fin self.size) (i) :
    parentD (findAux self x).s i = self.rootD i ∧ self.rootD i = self.rootD x ∨
    parentD (findAux self x).s i = self.parent i
proof:
:= by
  if h' : self.arr[x.1].parent = x then
    rw [findAux_s, ite_eq_left h']; exact .inr rfl
  else
    rw [parentD_findAux]
    split
    · simp [*]
    · have := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (self.lt_rankMax x) (self.rank'_lt _ _ ‹_›)
      refine (parentD_findAux_or self ⟨_, self.parent'_lt _ x.2⟩ i)
        |>.imp_left (.imp_right fun h => ?_)
      simp only [h, ← parentD_eq, rootD_parent]

name: lt_rankD_findAux
statement:
theorem lt_rankD_findAux {self : UnionFind} {x : Fin self.size} :
    parentD (findAux self x).s i ≠ i →
    self.rank i < self.rank (parentD (findAux self x).s i)
proof:
:= by
  if h' : self.arr[x.1].parent = x then
    rw [findAux_s, ite_eq_left h']; apply self.rank_lt
  else
    rw [parentD_findAux]; split <;> rename_i h <;> intro h'
    · subst i; rwa [lt_rank_root, Ne, ← rootD_eq_self]
    · have := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (self.lt_rankMax x) (self.rank'_lt _ _ ‹_›)
      apply lt_rankD_findAux h'

name: find_size
statement:
@[simp] theorem find_size (self : UnionFind) (x : Fin self.size) :
    (self.find x).1.size = self.size

name: find_root_2
statement:
@[simp] theorem find_root_2 (self : UnionFind) (x : Fin self.size) :
    (self.find x).2.1.1 = self.rootD x

name: find_parent_1
statement:
@[simp] theorem find_parent_1 (self : UnionFind) (x : Fin self.size) :
    (self.find x).1.parent x = self.rootD x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [parent, find]
  rw [parentD_findAux, ite_eq_left rfl]

name: find_parent_or
statement:
theorem find_parent_or (self : UnionFind) (x : Fin self.size) (i) :
    (self.find x).1.parent i = self.rootD i ∧ self.rootD i = self.rootD x ∨
    (self.find x).1.parent i = self.parent i

name: find_root_1
statement:
@[simp] theorem find_root_1 (self : UnionFind) (x : Fin self.size) (i : Nat) :
    (self.find x).1.rootD i = self.rootD i
proof:
:= by
  if h : (self.find x).1.parent i = i then
    rw [rootD_eq_self.2 h]
    obtain ⟨h1, _⟩ | h1 := find_parent_or self x i <;> rw [h1] at h
    · rw [h]
    · rw [rootD_eq_self.2 h]
  else
    have := Nat.sub_lt_sub_left ((self.find x).1.lt_rankMax _) ((self.find x).1.rank_lt h)
    rw [← rootD_parent, find_root_1 self x ((self.find x).1.parent i)]
    obtain ⟨h1, _⟩ | h1 := find_parent_or self x i
    · rw [h1, rootD_rootD]
    · rw [h1, rootD_parent]

name: setParentBump_rankD_lt
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ne_eq, hP, hR, implies_true] at *; split <;> rename_i h₁ <;> [simp [← h₁]; skip] <;>
    split <;> rename_i h₂ <;> intro h
  · simp [h₂] at h
  · simp only [rankD_eq, x.2, y.2]
    split <;> rename_i h₃
    · rw [← h₃]; apply Nat.lt_succ_self
    · exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne H h₃
  · cases h₂.1
    simp only [h₂.2, false_or, Nat.lt_irrefl] at hroot
    simp only [hroot, parentD_eq y.2, not_true_eq_false] at h
  · have := rankD_lt h
    split <;> rename_i h₃
    · rw [← rankD_eq, h₃.1]; exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt this
    · exact this

name: setParent_rankD_lt
proof:
:= arr.set x ⟨y, arr[x].rank⟩
    parentD arr' i ≠ i → rankD arr' i < rankD arr' (parentD arr' i) :=
  setParentBump_rankD_lt (.inl h) (Nat.le_of_lt h) rankD_lt parentD_set
    (by simp [rankD_set, Nat.ne_of_lt h, rankD_eq])

name: linkAux_size
statement: @[simp] theorem linkAux_size : (linkAux self x y).size = self.size
proof:
:= by
  simp only [linkAux]
  split <;> [rfl; split] <;> [skip; split] <;> simp

name: recAux_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem recAux_zero {motive : Nat → Sort _} (zero : motive 0)
    (succ : ∀ n, motive n → motive (n+1)) :
    Nat.recAux zero succ 0 = zero

name: recAux_succ

theorem recAux_succ {motive : Nat → Sort _} (zero : motive 0)
    (succ : ∀ n, motive n → motive (n+1)) (n) :

    (succ : ∀ n, motive n → motive (n+1)) :
    Nat.recAuxOn 0 zero succ = zero

name: recAuxOn_succ

theorem recAuxOn_succ {motive : Nat → Sort _} (zero : motive 0)
    (succ : ∀ n, motive n → motive (n+1)) (n) :
    Nat.recAuxOn (n+1) zero succ = succ n (Nat.recAuxOn n zero succ)

name: casesAuxOn_zero

@[simp] theorem casesAuxOn_zero {motive : Nat → Sort _} (zero : motive 0)

    Nat.casesAuxOn 0 zero succ = zero

name: casesAuxOn_succ

theorem casesAuxOn_succ {motive : Nat → Sort _} (zero : motive 0)

name: strongRec_eq
statement:
theorem strongRec_eq {motive : Nat → Sort _} (ind : ∀ n, (∀ m, m < n → motive m) → motive n)
    (t : Nat) : Nat.strongRec ind t = ind t fun m _ => Nat.strongRec ind m

name: strongRecOn_eq
statement:
theorem strongRecOn_eq {motive : Nat → Sort _} (ind : ∀ n, (∀ m, m < n → motive m) → motive n)
    (t : Nat) : Nat.strongRecOn t ind = ind t fun m _ => Nat.strongRecOn m ind

name: recDiagAux_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem recDiagAux_zero_left {motive : Nat → Nat → Sort _}
    (zero_left : ∀ n, motive 0 n) (zero_right : ∀ m, motive m 0)

name: ofBits_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ofBits_zero (f : Fin 0 → Bool) : ofBits f = 0

name: ofBits_succ
statement: theorem ofBits_succ (f : Fin (n+1) → Bool) : ofBits f = 2 * ofBits (f ∘ Fin.succ) + (f 0).toNat

name: ofBits_lt_two_pow
statement: theorem ofBits_lt_two_pow (f : Fin n → Bool) : ofBits f < 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    calc ofBits f
        = 2 * ofBits (f ∘ Fin.succ) + (f 0).toNat := ofBits_succ ..
      _ < 2 * (ofBits (f ∘ Fin.succ) + 1) := Nat.add_lt_add_left (Bool.toNat_lt _) ..
      _ ≤ 2 * 2 ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (ih ..)
      _ = 2 ^ (n + 1) := Nat.pow_add_one' .. |>.symm

name: testBit_ofBits_lt
statement:
@[simp] theorem testBit_ofBits_lt (f : Fin n → Bool) (i : Nat) (h : i < n) :
    (ofBits f).testBit i = f ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero => contradiction
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [ofBits_succ]
    match i with
    | 0 => simp [mod_eq_of_lt (Bool.toNat_lt _)]
    | i+1 =>
      rw [testBit_add_one, mul_add_div Nat.zero_lt_two, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (Bool.toNat_lt _)]
      exact ih (f ∘ Fin.succ) i (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h)

name: testBit_ofBits_ge
statement:
@[simp] theorem testBit_ofBits_ge (f : Fin n → Bool) (i : Nat) (h : n ≤ i) :
    (ofBits f).testBit i = false
proof:
:= by
  apply testBit_lt_two_pow
  apply Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
  · exact ofBits_lt_two_pow f
  · exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right Nat.zero_lt_two h

name: testBit_ofBits
statement:
theorem testBit_ofBits (f : Fin n → Bool) :
    (ofBits f).testBit i = if h : i < n then f ⟨i, h⟩ else false
proof:
:= by
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge i n with
  | inl h => simp [h]
  | inr h => simp [h, Nat.not_lt_of_ge h]

name: ofBits_testBit
statement: theorem ofBits_testBit (x n) : ofBits (fun i : Fin n => x.testBit i) = x % 2 ^ n

name: mul_add_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem mul_add_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt {m n x y : Nat} (hx : x < m) (hy : y < n) :
    n * x + y < m * n
proof:
:= calc
  _ < n * x + n := Nat.add_lt_add_left hy _
  _ = n * (x + 1) := Nat.mul_add_one .. |>.symm
  _ ≤ n * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hx
  _ = m * n := Nat.mul_comm ..

name: add_mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem add_mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt {m n x y : Nat} (hx : x < m) (hy : y < n) :
    x + m * y < m * n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_comm _ n]
  exact mul_add_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt hy hx

statement: theorem avg_lt_left (h : b < a) : avg a b < a

name: le_add_one_of_avg_eq_left
statement: theorem le_add_one_of_avg_eq_left (h : avg a b = a) : b ≤ a + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge b (a+2) with
  | inl hlt => exact Nat.le_of_lt_add_one hlt
  | inr hge =>
    absurd Nat.lt_irrefl a
    conv => rhs; rw [← h]
    rw [← Nat.add_one_le_iff, Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le Nat.zero_lt_two]
    omega

name: le_add_one_of_avg_eq_right

proof:
:= by
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge a (b+2) with
  | inl hlt => exact Nat.le_of_lt_add_one hlt
  | inr hge =>
    absurd Nat.lt_irrefl b
    conv => rhs; rw [← h]
    rw [← Nat.add_one_le_iff, Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le Nat.zero_lt_two]
    omega

name: bisect_lt_stop
statement:
theorem bisect_lt_stop {p : Nat → Bool} (h : start < stop) (hstart : p start = true)
    (hstop : p stop = false) : bisect h hstart hstop < stop
proof:
:= by
  unfold bisect
  simp only; split
  · split
    · next h' _ =>
      have : avg start stop - start < stop - start := by
        apply Nat.sub_lt_sub_right
        · exact Nat.le_of_lt h'
        · exact Nat.avg_lt_right h
      apply Nat.lt_trans
      · exact bisect_lt_stop ..
      · exact avg_lt_right h
    · exact bisect_lt_stop ..
  · exact avg_lt_right h

name: start_le_bisect
statement:
theorem start_le_bisect {p : Nat → Bool} (h : start < stop) (hstart : p start = true)
    (hstop : p stop = false) : start ≤ bisect h hstart hstop
proof:
:= by
  unfold bisect
  simp only; split
  · split
    · next h' _ =>
      have : avg start stop - start < stop - start := by
        apply Nat.sub_lt_sub_right
        · exact Nat.le_of_lt h'
        · exact avg_lt_right h
      exact start_le_bisect ..
    · next h' _ =>
      apply Nat.le_trans
      · exact Nat.le_of_lt h'
      · exact start_le_bisect ..
  · exact le_avg_left (Nat.le_of_lt h)

name: bisect_true
statement:
theorem bisect_true {p : Nat → Bool} (h : start < stop) (hstart : p start = true)
    (hstop : p stop = false) : p (bisect h hstart hstop) = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold bisect
  simp only; split
  · split
    · have : avg start stop - start < stop - start := by
        apply Nat.sub_lt_sub_right
        · exact Nat.le_avg_left (Nat.le_of_lt h)
        · exact Nat.avg_lt_right h
      exact bisect_true ..
    · exact bisect_true ..
  · next h' =>
    rw [← hstart]; congr
    apply Nat.le_antisymm
    · exact Nat.le_of_not_gt h'
    · exact Nat.le_avg_left (Nat.le_of_lt h)

name: bisect_add_one_false
statement:
theorem bisect_add_one_false {p : Nat → Bool} (h : start < stop) (hstart : p start = true)
    (hstop : p stop = false) : p (bisect h hstart hstop + 1) = false
proof:
:= by
  unfold bisect
  simp only; split
  · split
    · have : avg start stop - start < stop - start := by
        apply Nat.sub_lt_sub_right
        · exact Nat.le_avg_left (Nat.le_of_lt h)
        · exact Nat.avg_lt_right h
      exact bisect_add_one_false ..
    · exact bisect_add_one_false ..
  · next h' =>
    have heq : avg start stop = start := by
      apply Nat.le_antisymm
      · exact Nat.le_of_not_gt h'
      · exact Nat.le_avg_left (Nat.le_of_lt h)
    rw [← hstop, heq]; congr
    apply Nat.le_antisymm
    · exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt h
    · exact Nat.le_add_one_of_avg_eq_left heq

name: unpackSign_packComponents
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unpackSign_packComponents {spec : Format} (s e m) :
    unpackSign (packComponents spec s e m) = s.toBitVec
proof:
:= by
  ext i (_ | ⟨⟨⟩⟩)
  simp +arith [unpackSign, packComponents, BitVec.getElem_append]

name: packComponents_unpackSign_unpackExponent_unpackMantissa
statement:
theorem packComponents_unpackSign_unpackExponent_unpackMantissa
    {spec : Format} (b : BitVec spec.numBits) :
    packComponents spec
      (Sign.ofBitVec (unpackSign b)) (unpackExponent b) (unpackMantissa b) = b
proof:
:= by
  simp [packComponents]
  rw [unpackSign, unpackExponent, unpackMantissa]
  rw [BitVec.extractLsb'_append_extractLsb'_eq_extractLsb',
    BitVec.extractLsb'_append_extractLsb'_eq_extractLsb']
  · exact BitVec.extractLsb'_eq_self
  · simp
  · simp

name: pack_unpack
statement:
theorem pack_unpack {spec : Format} (b : BitVec spec.numBits) :
    (unpack spec b).pack spec = if isNaNBits b then packedNaN spec else b
proof:
:= by
  conv => rhs; rw [← packComponents_unpackSign_unpackExponent_unpackMantissa b]
  unfold isNaNBits
  fun_cases unpack with
  | case1 mvec evec svec s hevec hmvec =>
    
    simp +zetaDelta [pack, packedInfinity, hmvec, hevec]
  | case2 mvec evec hevec hmvec =>
    
    simp +zetaDelta [pack, packedNaN, hevec, hmvec]
  | case3 mvec evec svec s _ hevec hmvec =>
    
    simp +zetaDelta [pack, packedZero, hevec, hmvec]
  | case4 mvec evec e svec s _ hevec hmvec =>
    
    simp only [hevec, unpackExponent_packComponents, BitVec.zero_eq_neg_one_iff,
      Nat.ne_zero_of_lt spec.he, unpackMantissa_packComponents, ne_eq, false_and, decide_false,
      Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, evec]
    unfold pack
    extract_lets mantbits biasedexp
    simp only [BitVec.ofNat_toNat, BitVec.setWidth_eq, mvec]
    rw [ite_eq_right, ite_eq_right]
    · rw [Format.mantissaBits, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_cancel_iff]
      apply Nat.ne_of_lt
      have := mt BitVec.toNat_inj.mp hmvec
      simp only [BitVec.toNat_ofNat, Nat.zero_mod] at this
      simp only [ne_eq, this, not_false_eq_true, Nat.log2_lt, gt_iff_lt, mantbits]
      exact BitVec.isLt _
    · simp +arith [biasedexp, e, hevec]
      have := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (n := 2) (by decide) spec.he
      lia
  | case5 mvec evec e svec s hevec hevec' =>
    
    simp only [unpackExponent_packComponents, hevec, unpackMantissa_packComponents, ne_eq,
      false_and, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, evec]
    unfold pack
    extract_lets mantbits biasedexp
    rw [ite_eq_right, ite_eq_left]
    · congr 1
      · simp +arith [biasedexp, e, evec]
      · rw [BitVec.ofNat_toNat, BitVec.setWidth_append]
        simp [mvec]
    · subst mantbits
      have := Nat.two_pow_add_eq_or_of_lt mvec.isLt (a := 1)
      rw [Nat.mul_one] at this
      simp only [BitVec.toNat_append, BitVec.toNat_ofNat, Nat.pow_one, Nat.mod_succ,
        Format.mantissaBits, Nat.add_comm 1, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff,
        Nat.one_shiftLeft, ← this]
      rw [Nat.log2_eq_iff (by simp)]
      simp [Nat.two_pow_succ, mvec.isLt]
    · simp +arith [biasedexp, e]
      simp only [BitVec.neg_one_eq_allOnes, ← BitVec.lt_allOnes_iff, BitVec.lt_def,
        BitVec.toNat_allOnes] at hevec
      lia

name: pack_unpack_of_valid
statement:
theorem pack_unpack_of_valid {spec : Format} {b : BitVec spec.numBits}

name: unpack_inj_of_valid
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    replace h := congrArg (pack spec) h
    rwa [pack_unpack_of_valid hb, pack_unpack_of_valid hb'] at h
  · rintro rfl; rfl

name: isNaNBits_packedNaN
statement: theorem isNaNBits_packedNaN {spec : Format} : isNaNBits (packedNaN spec)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isNaNBits, packedNaN, unpackExponent_packComponents, unpackMantissa_packComponents,
    ne_eq, true_and, decide_not, Bool.not_eq_eq_eq_not, Bool.not_true, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
  intro h
  replace h := congrArg (·.getLsbD (spec.mantissaBitsWithoutImplicit - 1)) h
  simp [Nat.sub_one_lt (Nat.ne_of_gt spec.hm)] at h

name: unpack_packedNaN
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unpack_packedNaN {spec : Format} : unpack spec (packedNaN spec) = notANumber
proof:
:= by
  have := @isNaNBits_packedNaN spec
  simp only [isNaNBits, decide_eq_true_eq] at this
  simp [unpack, this]

name: beq_iff_ne_notANumber_and_eq
statement:
theorem beq_iff_ne_notANumber_and_eq (a b : UnpackedFloat) :
    a.beq b ↔ a ≠ notANumber ∧ b ≠ notANumber ∧
      (a = b ∨ (a = .zero .positive ∧ b = .zero .negative) ∨
        (a = .zero .negative ∧ b = .zero .positive))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [UnpackedFloat.beq, beq_iff_eq, ne_eq]
  fun_cases UnpackedFloat.compare a b <;> simp_all [eq_comm (α := UnpackedFloat), and_comm] <;>
    rename_i s₁ s₂ <;> revert s₁ s₂ <;> decide

name: unpack_beq_unpack_iff
statement:
theorem unpack_beq_unpack_iff {spec : Format} {b b' : BitVec spec.numBits}
    (hb : spec.Valid b) (hb' : spec.Valid b') :
    (unpack spec b).beq (unpack spec b') ↔ b ≠ packedNaN spec ∧ b' ≠ packedNaN spec ∧
        (b = b' ∨ (b = packedZero spec .positive ∧ b' = packedZero spec .negative) ∨

statement: theorem replaceF_of_forall_none {l : List α} (h : ∀ a, a ∈ l → p a = none) : l.replaceF p = l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ ih => simp [h _ (.head ..), ih (forall_mem_cons.1 h).2]

name: exists_of_replaceF
statement:
theorem exists_of_replaceF : ∀ {l : List α} {a a'} (_ : a ∈ l) (_ : p a = some a'),
    ∃ a a' l₁ l₂,
      (∀ b ∈ l₁, p b = none) ∧ p a = some a' ∧ l = l₁ ++ a :: l₂ ∧ l.replaceF p = l₁ ++ a' :: l₂
  | b :: l, _, _, al, pa =>
    match pb : p b with
    | some b' => ⟨b, b', [], l, forall_mem_nil _, pb, by simp [pb]⟩
    | none =>
      match al with
      | .head .. => nomatch pb.symm.trans pa
      | .tail _ al =>
        let ⟨c, c', l₁, l₂, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
proof:
:= exists_of_replaceF al pa
        ⟨c, c', b::l₁, l₂, (forall_mem_cons ..).2 ⟨pb, h₁⟩,
          h₂, by rw [h₃, cons_append], by simp [pb, h₄]⟩

name: exists_or_eq_self_of_replaceF
statement:
theorem exists_or_eq_self_of_replaceF (p) (l : List α) :
    l.replaceF p = l ∨ ∃ a a' l₁ l₂,
      (∀ b ∈ l₁, p b = none) ∧ p a = some a' ∧ l = l₁ ++ a :: l₂ ∧ l.replaceF p = l₁ ++ a' :: l₂
proof:
:=
  if h : ∃ a ∈ l, (p a).isSome then
    let ⟨_, ha, pa⟩ := h
    .inr (exists_of_replaceF ha (Option.get_mem pa))
  else
    .inl <| replaceF_of_forall_none fun a ha =>
      Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none.1 fun h' => h ⟨a, ha, h'⟩

name: cons_diff

proof:
:= by
  induction l₂ generalizing l₁ with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b l₂ ih =>
    by_cases h : a = b
    next => simp [*]

      have := Ne.symm h

  | l₁, a :: l₂ => (diff_cons l₁ l₂ a).trans (diff_eq_foldl _ _)

name: diff_sublist
statement:
theorem diff_sublist : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List α, l₁.diff l₂ <+ l₁
  | _, [] => .refl _
  | l₁, a :: l₂ =>
    calc
      l₁.diff (a :: l₂) = (l₁.erase a).diff l₂
proof:
:= diff_cons ..
      _ <+ l₁.erase a := diff_sublist ..
      _ <+ l₁ := erase_sublist ..

theorem mem_diff_of_mem {a : α} : ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List α}, a ∈ l₁ → a ∉ l₂ → a ∈ l₁.diff l₂
  | _, [], h₁, _ => h₁
  | l₁, b :: l₂, h₁, h₂ => by
    rw [diff_cons]
    exact mem_diff_of_mem ((mem_erase_of_ne <| ne_of_not_mem_cons h₂).2 h₁) (mt (.tail _) h₂)

theorem Sublist.diff_right : ∀ {l₁ l₂ l₃ : List α}, l₁ <+ l₂ → l₁.diff l₃ <+ l₂.diff l₃
  | _,  _, [], h => h
  | l₁, l₂, a :: l₃, h => by simp only [diff_cons, (h.erase _).diff_right]

name: Sublist.erase_diff_erase_sublist
statement:
theorem Sublist.erase_diff_erase_sublist {a : α} :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List α}, l₁ <+ l₂ → (l₂.erase a).diff (l₁.erase a) <+ l₂.diff l₁
  | [], _, _ => erase_sublist
  | b :: l₁, l₂, h => by
    if heq : b = a then
      simp [heq]
    else
      simp [heq, erase_comm a]
      exact (erase_cons_head b _ ▸ h.erase b).erase_diff_erase_sublist

name: disjoint_take_drop
statement:
theorem disjoint_take_drop : ∀ {l : List α}, l.Nodup → m ≤ n → Disjoint (l.take m) (l.drop n)
  | [], _, _ => by simp
  | x :: xs, hl, h => by
    cases m <;> cases n <;> simp only [disjoint_cons_left, drop, disjoint_nil_left,
      take]
    · case succ.zero => cases h
    · cases hl with | cons h₀ h₁ =>

name: dropPrefix
statement:
theorem dropPrefix?_eq_some_iff [BEq α] {l p s : List α} :
    dropPrefix? l p = some s ↔ ∃ p', l = p' ++ s ∧ p' == p
proof:
:= by
  unfold dropPrefix?
  split
  · simp
  · simp
  · rename_i a as b bs
    simp only [ite_none_right_eq_some]
    constructor
    · rw [dropPrefix?_eq_some_iff]
      rintro ⟨w, p', rfl, h⟩
      refine ⟨a :: p', by simp_all⟩
    · rw [dropPrefix?_eq_some_iff]
      rintro ⟨p, h, w⟩
      rw [cons_eq_append_iff] at h
      obtain (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨a', rfl, rfl⟩) := h
      · simp at w
      · simp only [cons_beq_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] at w
        refine ⟨w.1, a', rfl, w.2⟩

name: dropInfix
statement:
theorem dropInfix?_go_eq_some_iff [BEq α] {i l acc p s : List α} :
    dropInfix?.go i l acc = some (p, s) ↔ ∃ p',
      p = acc.reverse ++ p' ∧
      
      (∃ i', l = p' ++ i' ++ s ∧ i' == i) ∧
        
        (∀ p'' i'' s'', l = p'' ++ i'' ++ s'' → i'' == i → p''.length ≥ p'.length)
proof:
:= by
  unfold dropInfix?.go
  split
  · simp only [isEmpty_iff, ite_none_right_eq_some, some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, nil_eq,
      append_assoc, append_eq_nil_iff, ge_iff_le, and_imp]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
      simp
    · rintro ⟨p', rfl, ⟨_, ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, h⟩, w⟩
      simp_all
  · rename_i a t
    split <;> rename_i h
    · rw [dropInfix?_go_eq_some_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨p', rfl, ⟨i', rfl, h₂⟩, w⟩
        refine ⟨a :: p', ?_⟩
        simp [h₂]
        intro p'' i'' s'' h₁ h₂
        rw [cons_eq_append_iff] at h₁
        obtain (⟨rfl, h₁⟩ | ⟨p'', rfl, h₁⟩) := h₁
        · rw [append_assoc, ← h₁] at h
          have := dropPrefix?_append_of_beq s'' h₂
          simp_all
        · simpa using w p'' i'' s'' (by simpa using h₁) h₂
      · rintro ⟨p', rfl, ⟨i', h₁, h₂⟩, w⟩
        rw [cons_eq_append_iff] at h₁
        simp at h₁
        obtain (⟨⟨rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨a', h₁, rfl⟩) := h₁
        · simp only [nil_beq_eq, isEmpty_iff] at h₂
          simp only [h₂] at h
          simp at h
        · rw [append_eq_cons_iff] at h₁
          obtain (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p', rfl, rfl⟩) := h₁
          · rw [← cons_append] at h
            have := dropPrefix?_append_of_beq s h₂
            simp_all
          · refine ⟨p', ?_⟩
            simp only [reverse_cons, append_assoc, singleton_append, append_cancel_left_eq,
              append_cancel_right_eq, exists_eq_left', ge_iff_le, true_and]
            refine ⟨h₂, ?_⟩
            intro p'' i'' s'' h₃ h₄
            rw [← append_assoc] at h₃
            rw [h₃] at w
            simpa using w (a :: p'') i'' s'' (by simp) h₄
    · rename_i s'
      simp only [some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, append_assoc, ge_iff_le]
      rw [dropPrefix?_eq_some_iff] at h
      obtain ⟨p', h, w⟩ := h
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        simpa using ⟨p', by simp_all⟩
      · rintro ⟨p'', rfl, ⟨i', h₁, h₂⟩, w'⟩
        specialize w' [] p' s' (by simpa using h) w
        simp at w'
        simp [w'] at h₁ ⊢
        rw [h] at h₁
        apply append_inj_right h₁
        replace w := length_eq_of_beq w
        replace h₂ := length_eq_of_beq h₂
        simp_all

name: isSuffixOf
statement:
@[simp] theorem isSuffixOf?_eq_some_iff_append_eq [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {xs ys zs : List α} :
    xs.isSuffixOf? ys = some zs ↔ zs ++ xs = ys
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isSuffixOf?, map_eq_some_iff, isPrefixOf?_eq_some_iff_append_eq]
  constructor
  · intro
    | ⟨_, h, heq⟩ =>
      rw [List.reverse_eq_iff] at heq
      rw [heq] at h
      rw [← reverse_inj, reverse_append, h]
  · intro h
    exists zs.reverse
    simp [← h]

name: swap_eq
statement:
theorem swap_eq {xs : List α}  :
    xs.swap i j = if h : i < xs.length ∧ j < xs.length then
    (xs.set i xs[j]).set j xs[i] else xs
proof:
:= by induction xs generalizing i j with
  | nil => simp | cons a xs ih => cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp only [swap, ih, length_cons, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right] <;>
    split <;> simp_all [set_eq_of_length_le, Nat.not_lt]

name: swap_eq_of_ge_left
statement: @[simp] theorem swap_eq_of_ge_left {xs : List α} (h : xs.length ≤ i) : xs.swap i j = xs

name: swap_eq_of_ge_right
statement: @[simp] theorem swap_eq_of_ge_right {xs : List α} (h : xs.length ≤ j) : xs.swap i j = xs

name: swap_eq_of_lt
statement:
theorem swap_eq_of_lt {xs : List α} (hi :  i < xs.length) (hj : j < xs.length) :
    xs.swap i j = (xs.set i xs[j]).set j xs[i]

name: swap_self
statement: @[simp, grind =] theorem swap_self {xs : List α} {i : Nat} : xs.swap i i = xs
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hi | hi) := Nat.lt_or_ge i (xs.length)
  · rw [swap_eq_of_lt hi hi, set_getElem_self, set_getElem_self]
  · rw [swap_eq_of_ge_left hi]

name: swap_comm
statement: @[grind =] theorem swap_comm {xs : List α} {i j : Nat} : xs.swap i j = xs.swap j i
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hi | hi) := Nat.lt_or_ge i (xs.length)
  · obtain (hj | hj) := Nat.lt_or_ge j (xs.length)
    · rw [swap_eq_of_lt hi hj, swap_eq_of_lt hj hi]
      obtain (rfl | hij) := Decidable.em (i = j)
      · rfl
      · exact List.set_comm _ _ hij
    · rw [swap_eq_of_ge_right hj, swap_eq_of_ge_left hj]
  · rw [swap_eq_of_ge_left hi, swap_eq_of_ge_right hi]

name: length_swap
statement: @[simp, grind =] theorem length_swap {xs : List α} : (xs.swap i j).length = xs.length
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hi | hi) := Nat.lt_or_ge i (xs.length)
  · obtain (hj | hj) := Nat.lt_or_ge j (xs.length)
    · rw [swap_eq_of_lt hi hj, length_set, length_set]
    · rw [swap_eq_of_ge_right hj]
  · rw [swap_eq_of_ge_left hi]

name: getElem_swap_left
statement:
theorem getElem_swap_left {xs : List α} {i j : Nat} (hi : i < (xs.swap i j).length) :
    (xs.swap i j)[i] = if hj : j < xs.length then xs[j] else xs[i]'(length_swap ▸ hi)
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hj | hj) := Nat.lt_or_ge j xs.length
  · simp only [swap_eq_of_lt (length_swap ▸ hi) hj, hj, getElem_set, dite_true]
    split <;> simp_all
  · simp [swap_eq_of_ge_right hj, Nat.not_lt_of_ge hj]

name: getElem_swap_right
statement:
theorem getElem_swap_right {xs : List α} {i j : Nat} (hj : j < (xs.swap i j).length) :
    (xs.swap i j)[j] = if hi : i < xs.length then xs[i] else xs[j]'(length_swap ▸ hj)

name: getElem_swap_of_ne
statement:
@[simp] theorem getElem_swap_of_ne {xs : List α} {i j k : Nat} (hik : k ≠ i) (hjk : k ≠ j)
    (hk : k < (xs.swap i j).length) : (xs.swap i j)[k] = xs[k]'(length_swap ▸ hk)
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hi | hi) := Nat.lt_or_ge i (xs.length)
  · obtain (hj | hj) := Nat.lt_or_ge j (xs.length)
    · simp only [swap_eq_of_lt hi hj, getElem_set, hik.symm, hjk.symm, ite_false]
    · exact getElem_congr_coll (swap_eq_of_ge_right hj)
  · exact getElem_congr_coll (swap_eq_of_ge_left hi)

name: getElem_swap_left_of_lt
statement:
@[simp] theorem getElem_swap_left_of_lt {xs : List α} {i j : Nat} (hj : j < xs.length)
    (hi : i < (xs.swap i j).length) : (xs.swap i j)[i] = xs[j]

name: getElem_swap_right_of_lt
statement:
@[simp] theorem getElem_swap_right_of_lt {xs : List α} {i j : Nat} (hi : i < xs.length)
    (hj : j < (xs.swap i j).length) : (xs.swap i j)[j] = xs[i]

name: getElem_swap
proof:
:= by
  obtain (rfl | hi) := Decidable.em (k = i)
  · simp only [getElem_swap_left, true_and]
    exact dite_congr rfl (fun _ => rfl) (by simp)
  · obtain (rfl | hj) := Decidable.em (k = j)
    · simp [getElem_swap_right, hi]
    · simp [getElem_swap_of_ne, hi, hj]

name: pairwise_iff_get
statement: theorem pairwise_iff_get : Pairwise R l ↔ ∀ (i j) (_hij : i < j), R (get l i) (get l j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairwise_iff_getElem]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · intros i j h'
    exact h _ _ _ _ h'
  · intros i j hi hj h'
    exact h ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ h'

name: pwFilter_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem pwFilter_nil [DecidableRel R] : pwFilter R [] = []

name: pwFilter_cons_of_pos
statement:
@[simp] theorem pwFilter_cons_of_pos [DecidableRel (α := α) R] {a : α} {l : List α}
    (h : ∀ b ∈ pwFilter R l, R a b) : pwFilter R (a :: l) = a :: pwFilter R l

name: pwFilter_cons_of_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem pwFilter_cons_of_neg [DecidableRel (α := α) R] {a : α} {l : List α}
    (h : ¬∀ b ∈ pwFilter R l, R a b) : pwFilter R (a :: l) = pwFilter R l

name: pwFilter_map
statement:
theorem pwFilter_map [DecidableRel (α := α) R] (f : β → α) :
    ∀ l : List β, pwFilter R (map f l) = map f (pwFilter (fun x y => R (f x) (f y)) l)
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: xs => by
    if h : ∀ b ∈ pwFilter R (map f xs), R (f x) b then
      have h' : ∀ b : β, b ∈ pwFilter (fun x y : β => R (f x) (f y)) xs → R (f x) (f b)
proof:
:=
        fun b hb => h _ (by rw [pwFilter_map f xs]; apply mem_map_of_mem hb)
      rw [map, pwFilter_cons_of_pos h, pwFilter_cons_of_pos h', pwFilter_map f xs, map]
    else
      rw [map, pwFilter_cons_of_neg h, pwFilter_cons_of_neg ?_, pwFilter_map f xs]
      refine fun hh => h fun a ha => ?_
      rw [pwFilter_map f xs, mem_map] at ha
      let ⟨b, hb₀, hb₁⟩ := ha; exact hb₁ ▸ hh _ hb₀

name: pwFilter_sublist
statement:
theorem pwFilter_sublist [DecidableRel (α := α) R] : ∀ l : List α, pwFilter R l <+ l
  | [] => nil_sublist _
  | x :: l =>
    if h : ∀ y ∈ pwFilter R l, R x y then
      pwFilter_cons_of_pos h ▸ (pwFilter_sublist l).cons_cons _
    else
      pwFilter_cons_of_neg h ▸ Sublist.cons _ (pwFilter_sublist l)

name: pwFilter_subset
statement: theorem pwFilter_subset [DecidableRel (α := α) R] (l : List α) : pwFilter R l ⊆ l

name: pairwise_pwFilter
statement:
theorem pairwise_pwFilter [DecidableRel (α := α) R] : ∀ l : List α, Pairwise R (pwFilter R l)
  | [] => Pairwise.nil
  | x :: l =>
    if h : ∀ y ∈ pwFilter R l, R x y then
      pwFilter_cons_of_pos h ▸ pairwise_cons.2 ⟨h, pairwise_pwFilter l⟩
    else
      pwFilter_cons_of_neg h ▸ pairwise_pwFilter l

name: pwFilter_eq_self
statement:
theorem pwFilter_eq_self [DecidableRel (α := α) R] {l : List α} :
    pwFilter R l = l ↔ Pairwise R l
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun e => e ▸ pairwise_pwFilter l, fun p => ?_⟩
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x l IH =>
    let ⟨al, p⟩ := pairwise_cons.1 p
    rw [pwFilter_cons_of_pos fun b hb => ?_, IH p]
    rw [IH p] at hb
    exact al _ hb

name: pwFilter_idem
statement:
@[simp] theorem pwFilter_idem [DecidableRel (α := α) R] :
    pwFilter R (pwFilter R l) = pwFilter R l

name: forall_mem_pwFilter
statement:
theorem forall_mem_pwFilter [DecidableRel (α := α) R]
    (neg_trans : ∀ {x y z}, R x z → R x y ∨ R y z) (a : α) (l : List α) :
    (∀ b ∈ pwFilter R l, R a b) ↔ ∀ b ∈ l, R a b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h b hb => h _ <| pwFilter_subset (R := R) _ hb⟩
  induction l with
  | nil => exact fun _ _ h => (not_mem_nil h).elim
  | cons x l IH =>
    simp only [forall_mem_cons]
    if h : ∀ y ∈ pwFilter R l, R x y then
      simpa [pwFilter_cons_of_pos h] using fun r H => ⟨r, IH H⟩
    else
      refine pwFilter_cons_of_neg h ▸ fun H => ⟨?_, IH H⟩
      match e : find? (fun y => ¬R x y) (pwFilter R l) with
      | none => exact h.elim fun y hy => by simpa using find?_eq_none.1 e y hy
      | some k =>
        have := find?_some e
        apply (neg_trans (H k (mem_of_find?_eq_some e))).resolve_right
        rw [decide_eq_true_iff] at this; exact this

name: toArrayMap_toList
statement: theorem toArrayMap_toList (l : List α) (f : α → β ) : (l.toArrayMap f).toList = l.map f
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ arr : Array β, (l.foldl (init := arr) fun acc x => acc.push (f x)).toList
      = arr.toList ++ l.map f from
    this #[]
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons head tail tail_ih =>
    intro arr
    have : arr.toList ++ f head :: map f tail = (arr.push (f head)).toList ++ map f tail := by simp
    rw [List.foldl_cons, List.map_cons, this, ← tail_ih]

name: toArrayMap_eq_toArray_map
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem toArrayMap_eq_toArray_map (l : List α) (f : α → β) : l.toArrayMap f = (l.map f).toArray
proof:
:=
  Array.ext' (by simpa using toArrayMap_toList l f)

theorem length_partialSums [Add α] [Zero α] {l : List α} :

name: partialSums_nil
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem partialSums_nil [Add α] [Zero α] : ([] : List α).partialSums = [0]

name: partialSums_cons
statement:
theorem partialSums_cons [Add α] [Zero α] [Std.Associative (α := α) (· + ·)]
    [Std.LawfulIdentity (α := α) (· + ·) 0] {l : List α} :
    (a :: l).partialSums = 0 :: l.partialSums.map (a + ·)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [partialSums, scanl_cons, Std.LawfulLeftIdentity.left_id, cons.injEq]
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    simp only [Std.LawfulRightIdentity.right_id, scanl_nil, map_cons, map_nil]
  | cons b l ih =>
    simp [Std.LawfulLeftIdentity.left_id, Std.LawfulRightIdentity.right_id]
    rw [ih (a := b), ih (a := a + b), map_map]
    congr; funext; simp [Std.Associative.assoc]

name: partialSums_append
statement:
theorem partialSums_append [Add α] [Zero α] [Std.Associative (α := α) (· + ·)]
    [Std.LawfulIdentity (α := α) (· + ·) 0] {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    (l₁ ++ l₂).partialSums = l₁.partialSums ++ l₂.partialSums.tail.map (l₁.sum + · )
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => cases l₂ <;> simp [partialSums, Std.LawfulLeftIdentity.left_id]
  | cons _ _ ih =>
    simp only [cons_append, partialSums_cons, ih, map_tail, map_append, map_map, sum_cons,
      cons.injEq, append_cancel_left_eq, true_and]
    congr 2; funext; simp [Std.Associative.assoc]

theorem getElem_partialSums [Add α] [Zero α] [Std.Associative (α := α) (· + ·)]

name: partialProds_nil
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem partialProds_nil [Mul α] [One α]

name: partialProds_cons
statement:
theorem partialProds_cons [Mul α] [One α] [Std.Associative (α := α) (· * ·)]
    [Std.LawfulIdentity (α := α) (· * ·) 1] {l : List α} :
    (a :: l).partialProds = 1 :: l.partialProds.map (a * ·)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [partialProds, scanl_cons, Std.LawfulLeftIdentity.left_id, cons.injEq]
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    simp only [Std.LawfulRightIdentity.right_id, scanl_nil, map_cons, map_nil]
  | cons b l ih =>
    simp [Std.LawfulLeftIdentity.left_id, Std.LawfulRightIdentity.right_id]
    rw [ih (a := b), ih (a := a * b), map_map]
    congr; funext; simp [Std.Associative.assoc]

name: partialProds_append
statement:
theorem partialProds_append [Mul α] [One α] [Std.Associative (α := α) (· * ·)]
    [Std.LawfulIdentity (α := α) (· * ·) 1] {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    (l₁ ++ l₂).partialProds = l₁.partialProds ++ l₂.partialProds.tail.map (l₁.prod * · )
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => cases l₂ <;> simp [partialProds, Std.LawfulLeftIdentity.left_id]
  | cons _ _ ih =>
    simp only [cons_append, partialProds_cons, ih, map_tail, map_append, map_map, prod_cons,
      cons.injEq, append_cancel_left_eq, true_and]
    congr 2; funext; simp [Std.Associative.assoc]

theorem getElem_partialProds [Mul α] [One α] [Std.Associative (α := α) (· * ·)]

name: length_flatten_mem_partialSums_map_length
statement:
theorem length_flatten_mem_partialSums_map_length (L : List (List α)) :
    L.flatten.length ∈ (L.map length).partialSums
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons l L ih =>
    simp [flatten_cons, partialSums_cons]
    right
    simpa using ih

name: getElem_flatten_aux
statement:
theorem getElem_flatten_aux₁ (L : List (List α)) (i : Nat) (h : i < L.flatten.length) :
    (L.map length).partialSums.findIdx (· > i) - 1 < L.length
proof:
:= by
  have := findIdx_lt_length_of_exists
    (xs := (L.map length).partialSums) (p := fun x => decide (x > i))
  specialize this ⟨L.flatten.length,
    length_flatten_mem_partialSums_map_length L, by grind⟩
  simp at this
  simp
  have : 0 < findIdx (fun x => decide (i < x)) (map length L).partialSums := by
    by_contra w
    simp at w
  omega

name: getElem_flatten_aux
statement:
theorem getElem_flatten_aux₂ (L : List (List α)) (i : Nat) (h : i < L.flatten.length) :
    let j
proof:
:= (L.map length).partialSums.findIdx (· > i) - 1
    have hj : j < L.length := getElem_flatten_aux₁ L i h
    let k := i - (L.take j).flatten.length
    k < L[j].length := by
  induction L generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons l L ih =>
    simp only [map_cons, partialSums_cons, findIdx_cons, Nat.not_lt_zero, decide_false,
      findIdx_map, Function.comp_def, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, Nat.add_one_sub_one,
      length_flatten, map_take, getElem_cons]
    split <;> rename_i h'
    · simp only [h', take_zero, sum_nil, Nat.sub_zero]
      rw [findIdx_eq (by simp)] at h'
      simp_all
    · have : l.length ≤ i := by
        rw [findIdx_eq (by simp)] at h'
        simp_all
      rw [take_cons (by grind)]
      specialize ih (i - l.length) (by grind)
      have p : ∀ x, i - l.length < x ↔ i < l.length + x := by grind
      simp only [p, length_flatten, map_take] at ih
      grind

name: getElem_flatten
statement:
theorem getElem_flatten (L : List (List α)) (i : Nat) (h : i < L.flatten.length) :
    L.flatten[i] =
      let j
proof:
:= (L.map length).partialSums.findIdx (· > i) - 1
      have hj : j < L.length := getElem_flatten_aux₁ L i h
      let k := i - (L.take j).flatten.length
      have hk : k < L[j].length := getElem_flatten_aux₂ L i h
      L[j][k] := by
  induction L generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons l L ih =>
    simp only [flatten_cons, getElem_append]
    split <;> rename_i h'
    · have : findIdx (fun x => decide (x > i)) (map length (l :: L)).partialSums = 1 := by
        simp [partialSums_cons, findIdx_cons]
        rw [findIdx_eq] <;> grind
      simp only [this]
      simp
    · rw [ih]
      have : findIdx (fun x => decide (x > i)) (map length (l :: L)).partialSums =
          findIdx (fun x => decide (x > i - l.length)) (map length L).partialSums + 1 := by
        simp [partialSums_cons, findIdx_cons, Function.comp_def]
        congr
        funext x
        grind
      simp only [this]
      simp only [getElem_cons]
      split <;> rename_i h''
      · simp [findIdx_eq] at h''
      · congr 1
        rw [take_cons]
        · simp
          omega
        · simp

name: nil_subperm
statement: @[simp] theorem nil_subperm {l : List α} : [] <+~ l

name: Perm.subperm_left
statement: theorem Perm.subperm_left {l l₁ l₂ : List α} (p : l₁ ~ l₂) : l <+~ l₁ ↔ l <+~ l₂
proof:
:=
  suffices ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List α}, l₁ ~ l₂ → l <+~ l₁ → l <+~ l₂ from ⟨this p, this p.symm⟩
  fun p ⟨_u, pu, su⟩ =>
  let ⟨v, pv, sv⟩ := exists_perm_sublist su p
  ⟨v, pv.trans pu, sv⟩

name: Perm.subperm_right
statement: theorem Perm.subperm_right {l₁ l₂ l : List α} (p : l₁ ~ l₂) : l₁ <+~ l ↔ l₂ <+~ l
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨u, pu, su⟩ => ⟨u, pu.trans p, su⟩, fun ⟨u, pu, su⟩ => ⟨u, pu.trans p.symm, su⟩⟩

name: Sublist.subperm
statement: theorem Sublist.subperm {l₁ l₂ : List α} (s : l₁ <+ l₂) : l₁ <+~ l₂

name: Perm.subperm
statement: theorem Perm.subperm {l₁ l₂ : List α} (p : l₁ ~ l₂) : l₁ <+~ l₂

name: Subperm.refl
statement: @[refl] theorem Subperm.refl (l : List α) : l <+~ l

name: Subperm.trans
statement: theorem Subperm.trans {l₁ l₂ l₃ : List α} (s₁₂ : l₁ <+~ l₂) (s₂₃ : l₂ <+~ l₃) : l₁ <+~ l₃
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_l₂', p₂, s₂⟩ := s₂₃
  let ⟨l₁', p₁, s₁⟩ := p₂.subperm_left.2 s₁₂
  ⟨l₁', p₁, s₁.trans s₂⟩

name: Subperm.cons_self
statement: theorem Subperm.cons_self : l <+~ a :: l

name: Subperm.cons_right
statement: theorem Subperm.cons_right {α : Type _} {l l' : List α} (x : α) (h : l <+~ l') : l <+~ x :: l'

name: Subperm.length_le
statement:
theorem Subperm.length_le {l₁ l₂ : List α} : l₁ <+~ l₂ → length l₁ ≤ length l₂
  | ⟨_l, p, s⟩ => p.length_eq ▸ s.length_le

name: Subperm.perm_of_length_le
statement:
theorem Subperm.perm_of_length_le {l₁ l₂ : List α} : l₁ <+~ l₂ → length l₂ ≤ length l₁ → l₁ ~ l₂
  | ⟨_l, p, s⟩, h => (s.eq_of_length_le <| p.symm.length_eq ▸ h) ▸ p.symm

name: Subperm.antisymm
statement: theorem Subperm.antisymm {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h₁ : l₁ <+~ l₂) (h₂ : l₂ <+~ l₁) : l₁ ~ l₂

name: Subperm.subset
statement:
theorem Subperm.subset {l₁ l₂ : List α} : l₁ <+~ l₂ → l₁ ⊆ l₂
  | ⟨_l, p, s⟩ => Subset.trans p.symm.subset s.subset

name: Subperm.filter
statement:
theorem Subperm.filter (p : α → Bool) ⦃l l' : List α⦄ (h : l <+~ l') :
    filter p l <+~ filter p l'
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨xs, hp, h⟩ := h
  exact ⟨_, hp.filter p, h.filter p⟩

name: subperm_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem subperm_nil : l <+~ [] ↔ l = []
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => length_eq_zero_iff.1 $ Nat.le_zero.1 h.length_le, by rintro rfl; rfl⟩

name: singleton_subperm_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem singleton_subperm_iff {α} {l : List α} {a : α} : [a] <+~ l ↔ a ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨s, hla, h⟩ => ?_, fun h => ⟨[a], .rfl, singleton_sublist.mpr h⟩⟩
  rwa [perm_singleton.mp hla, singleton_sublist] at h

name: Subperm.countP_le
statement:
theorem Subperm.countP_le (p : α → Bool) {l₁ l₂ : List α} : l₁ <+~ l₂ → countP p l₁ ≤ countP p l₂
  | ⟨_l, p', s⟩ => p'.countP_eq p ▸ s.countP_le

name: Subperm.count_le
statement:
theorem Subperm.count_le [BEq α] {l₁ l₂ : List α} (s : l₁ <+~ l₂) (a) :
    count a l₁ ≤ count a l₂

name: subperm_cons
statement: theorem subperm_cons (a : α) {l₁ l₂ : List α} : a :: l₁ <+~ a :: l₂ ↔ l₁ <+~ l₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨l, p, s⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨l, p, s⟩ => ⟨a :: l, p.cons a, s.cons_cons _⟩⟩
  match s with
  | .cons _ s' => exact (p.subperm_left.2 <| (sublist_cons_self _ _).subperm).trans s'.subperm
  | .cons_cons _ s' => exact ⟨_, p.cons_inv, s'⟩

name: cons_subperm_of_not_mem_of_mem
statement:
theorem cons_subperm_of_not_mem_of_mem {a : α} {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h₁ : a ∉ l₁) (h₂ : a ∈ l₂)
    (s : l₁ <+~ l₂) : a :: l₁ <+~ l₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, p, s⟩ := s
  induction s generalizing l₁ with
  | slnil => cases h₂
  | @cons r₁ _ b s' ih =>
    simp at h₂
    match h₂ with
    | .inl e => subst_vars; exact ⟨_ :: r₁, p.cons _, s'.cons_cons _⟩
    | .inr m => let ⟨t, p', s'⟩ := ih h₁ m p; exact ⟨t, p', s'.cons _⟩
  | @cons_cons _ r₂ b _ ih =>
    have bm : b ∈ l₁ := p.subset mem_cons_self
    have am : a ∈ r₂ := by
      simp only [mem_cons] at h₂
      exact h₂.resolve_left fun e => h₁ <| e.symm ▸ bm
    obtain ⟨t₁, t₂, rfl⟩ := append_of_mem bm
    have st : t₁ ++ t₂ <+ t₁ ++ b :: t₂ := by simp
    obtain ⟨t, p', s'⟩ := ih (mt (st.subset ·) h₁) am (.cons_inv <| p.trans perm_middle)
    exact ⟨b :: t, (p'.cons b).trans <|
    (Perm.swap ..).trans (perm_middle.symm.cons a), s'.cons_cons _⟩

name: subperm_append_left
statement:
theorem subperm_append_left {l₁ l₂ : List α} : ∀ l, l ++ l₁ <+~ l ++ l₂ ↔ l₁ <+~ l₂
  | [] => .rfl
  | a :: l => (subperm_cons a).trans (subperm_append_left l)

name: subperm_append_right
statement: theorem subperm_append_right {l₁ l₂ : List α} (l) : l₁ ++ l <+~ l₂ ++ l ↔ l₁ <+~ l₂

name: Subperm.exists_of_length_lt
statement:
theorem Subperm.exists_of_length_lt {l₁ l₂ : List α} (s : l₁ <+~ l₂) (h : length l₁ < length l₂) :
    ∃ a, a :: l₁ <+~ l₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, p, s⟩ := s
  suffices length l < length l₂ → ∃ a : α, a :: l <+~ l₂ from
    (this <| p.symm.length_eq ▸ h).imp fun a => (p.cons a).subperm_right.1
  clear h p l₁
  induction s with intro h
  | slnil => cases h
  | cons a s IH =>
    match Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h) with
    | .inl h => exact (IH h).imp fun a s => s.trans (sublist_cons_self _ _).subperm
    | .inr h => exact ⟨a, s.eq_of_length h ▸ .refl _⟩
  | cons_cons b _ IH =>
    exact (IH <| Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h).imp fun a s =>
      (Perm.swap ..).subperm_right.1 <| (subperm_cons _).2 s

name: subperm_of_subset
statement: theorem subperm_of_subset (d : Nodup l₁) (H : l₁ ⊆ l₂) : l₁ <+~ l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | nil => exact ⟨nil, .nil, nil_sublist _⟩
  | cons h _ IH =>
    have ⟨H₁, H₂⟩ := forall_mem_cons.1 H
    exact cons_subperm_of_not_mem_of_mem (h _ · rfl) H₁ (IH H₂)

name: Nodup.perm_iff_eq_of_sublist
statement:
theorem Nodup.perm_iff_eq_of_sublist {l₁ l₂ l : List α} (d : Nodup l)
    (s₁ : l₁ <+ l) (s₂ : l₂ <+ l) : l₁ ~ l₂ ↔ l₁ = l₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by rw [h]⟩
  induction s₂ generalizing l₁ with simp [Nodup, List.forall_mem_ne] at d
  | slnil => exact h.eq_nil
  | cons a s₂ IH =>
    match s₁ with
    | .cons _ s₁ => exact IH d.2 s₁ h
    | .cons_cons _ s₁ =>
      have := Subperm.subset ⟨_, h.symm, s₂⟩ (.head _)
      exact (d.1 this).elim
  | cons_cons a _ IH =>
    match s₁ with
    | .cons _ s₁ =>
      have := Subperm.subset ⟨_, h, s₁⟩ (.head _)
      exact (d.1 this).elim
    | .cons_cons _ s₁ => rw [IH d.2 s₁ h.cons_inv]

name: subperm_cons_erase
statement: theorem subperm_cons_erase [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (a : α) (l : List α) : l <+~ a :: l.erase a
proof:
:=
  if h : a ∈ l then
    (perm_cons_erase h).subperm
  else
    (erase_of_not_mem h).symm ▸ (sublist_cons_self _ _).subperm

name: erase_subperm
statement: theorem erase_subperm [BEq α] (a : α) (l : List α) : l.erase a <+~ l

name: Subperm.erase
statement: theorem Subperm.erase [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (a : α) (h : l₁ <+~ l₂) : l₁.erase a <+~ l₂.erase a
proof:
:=
  let ⟨l, hp, hs⟩ := h
  ⟨l.erase a, hp.erase _, hs.erase _⟩

name: Perm.diff_right
statement:
theorem Perm.diff_right [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (t : List α) (h : l₁ ~ l₂) :
    l₁.diff t ~ l₂.diff t
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing l₁ l₂ h with simp only [List.diff]
  | nil => exact h
  | cons x t ih =>
    simp only [elem_eq_mem, decide_eq_true_eq, Perm.mem_iff h]
    split
    · exact ih (h.erase _)
    · exact ih h

name: Perm.diff_left
statement:
theorem Perm.diff_left [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (l : List α) (h : t₁ ~ t₂) :
    l.diff t₁ = l.diff t₂
proof:
:= by
  induction h generalizing l with try simp [List.diff]
  | cons x _ ih => apply ite_congr rfl <;> (intro; apply ih)
  | swap x y =>
    if h : x = y then
      simp [h]
    else
      simp [mem_erase_of_ne h, mem_erase_of_ne (Ne.symm h), erase_comm x y]
      split <;> simp
  | trans => simp only [*]

name: Perm.diff
statement:
theorem Perm.diff [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l₁ l₂ t₁ t₂ : List α} (hl : l₁ ~ l₂) (ht : t₁ ~ t₂) :
    l₁.diff t₁ ~ l₂.diff t₂

name: Subperm.diff_right
statement:
theorem Subperm.diff_right [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (h : l₁ <+~ l₂) (t : List α) :
    l₁.diff t <+~ l₂.diff t
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing l₁ l₂ h with simp [List.diff, *]
  | cons x t ih =>
    split <;> rename_i hx1
    · simp [h.subset hx1]
      exact ih (h.erase _)
    · split
      · rw [← erase_of_not_mem hx1]
        exact ih (h.erase _)
      · exact ih h

name: erase_cons_subperm_cons_erase
statement:
theorem erase_cons_subperm_cons_erase [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (a b : α) (l : List α) :
    (a :: l).erase b <+~ a :: l.erase b
proof:
:= by
  if h : a = b then
    rw [h, erase_cons_head]; apply subperm_cons_erase
  else
    have : ¬(a == b) = true := by simp only [beq_false_of_ne h, not_false_eq_true, reduceCtorEq]
    rw [erase_cons_tail this]

name: subperm_cons_diff
statement:
theorem subperm_cons_diff [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a : α} {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    (a :: l₁).diff l₂ <+~ a :: l₁.diff l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₂ with
  | nil => exact ⟨a :: l₁, by simp [List.diff]⟩
  | cons b l₂ ih =>
    rw [diff_cons, diff_cons, ← diff_erase, ← diff_erase]
    exact Subperm.trans (.erase _ ih) (erase_cons_subperm_cons_erase ..)

name: subset_cons_diff
statement:
theorem subset_cons_diff [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a : α} {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    (a :: l₁).diff l₂ ⊆ a :: l₁.diff l₂

name: subperm_append_diff_self_of_count_le
statement:
theorem subperm_append_diff_self_of_count_le [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l₁ l₂ : List α}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ l₁, count x l₁ ≤ count x l₂) : l₁ ++ l₂.diff l₁ ~ l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    have : hd ∈ l₂ := by
      rw [← count_pos_iff]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (count_pos_iff.mpr (.head _)) (h hd (.head _))
    have := perm_cons_erase this
    refine Perm.trans ?_ this.symm
    rw [cons_append, diff_cons, perm_cons]
    refine IH fun x hx => ?_
    specialize h x (.tail _ hx)
    rw [perm_iff_count.mp this] at h
    if hx : hd = x then subst hd; simpa [Nat.succ_le_succ_iff] using h
    else simpa [hx] using h

name: subperm_ext_iff
statement:
theorem subperm_ext_iff [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    l₁ <+~ l₂ ↔ ∀ x ∈ l₁, count x l₁ ≤ count x l₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x _ => h.count_le x, fun h => ?_⟩
  have : l₁ <+~ l₂.diff l₁ ++ l₁ := (subperm_append_right l₁).mpr nil_subperm
  refine this.trans (Perm.subperm ?_)
  exact perm_append_comm.trans (subperm_append_diff_self_of_count_le h)

name: isSubperm_iff
statement: theorem isSubperm_iff [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l₁ l₂ : List α} : l₁.isSubperm l₂ ↔ l₁ <+~ l₂

name: Subperm.cons_left
statement:
theorem Subperm.cons_left [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (h : l₁ <+~ l₂) (x : α)
    (hx : count x l₁ < count x l₂) : x :: l₁ <+~ l₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [subperm_ext_iff] at h ⊢
  intro y hy
  if hy' : y = x then
    subst x; simpa using Nat.succ_le_of_lt hx
  else
    rw [count_cons_of_ne (Ne.symm hy')]
    refine h y ?_
    simpa [hy'] using hy

name: Perm.union_right
statement:
theorem Perm.union_right [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (t₁ : List α) (h : l₁ ~ l₂) :
    l₁ ∪ t₁ ~ l₂ ∪ t₁
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a _ ih => exact ih.insert a
  | swap => apply perm_insert_swap
  | trans _ _ ih_1 ih_2 => exact ih_1.trans ih_2

name: Perm.union_left
statement: theorem Perm.union_left [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (l : List α) (h : t₁ ~ t₂) : l ∪ t₁ ~ l ∪ t₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [nil_union, h]
  | cons _ _ ih => simp only [cons_union, Perm.insert _ ih]

name: Perm.union
statement:
theorem Perm.union [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l₁ l₂ t₁ t₂ : List α} (p₁ : l₁ ~ l₂) (p₂ : t₁ ~ t₂) :
    l₁ ∪ t₁ ~ l₂ ∪ t₂

name: Perm.inter_right
statement: theorem Perm.inter_right [BEq α] (t₁ : List α) : l₁ ~ l₂ → l₁ ∩ t₁ ~ l₂ ∩ t₁

name: Perm.inter_left
statement: theorem Perm.inter_left [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (l : List α) (p : t₁ ~ t₂) : l ∩ t₁ = l ∩ t₂
proof:
:=
  filter_congr fun a _ => by simpa using p.mem_iff (a := a)

name: Perm.inter
statement:
theorem Perm.inter [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l₁ l₂ t₁ t₂ : List α} (p₁ : l₁ ~ l₂) (p₂ : t₁ ~ t₂) :
    l₁ ∩ t₁ ~ l₂ ∩ t₂

name: Perm.flatten_congr
statement:
theorem Perm.flatten_congr :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List (List α)} (_ : List.Forall₂ (· ~ ·) l₁ l₂), l₁.flatten ~ l₂.flatten
  | _, _, .nil => .rfl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, .cons h₁ h₂ => h₁.append (Perm.flatten_congr h₂)

name: perm_insertP
statement: theorem perm_insertP (p : α → Bool) (a l) : insertP p a l ~ a :: l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with simp [insertP, insertP.loop, cond]
  | cons _ _ ih =>
    split
    · exact Perm.refl ..
    · rw [insertP_loop, reverseAux, reverseAux]
      exact Perm.trans (Perm.cons _ ih) (Perm.swap ..)

name: Perm.insertP
statement: theorem Perm.insertP (p : α → Bool) (a) (h : l₁ ~ l₂) : insertP p a l₁ ~ insertP p a l₂

name: getD_set_perm_cons
statement:
theorem getD_set_perm_cons : ∀ (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (v : α),
    xs[i]?.getD v :: xs.set i v ~ v :: xs
  | [], _, _ => .refl _
  | a :: xs, 0, v => Perm.swap v a xs
  | a :: xs, i+1, v =>
    (Perm.swap a _ _).trans <| ((xs.getD_set_perm_cons i v).cons a).trans <| Perm.swap v a xs

name: cons_uncurry_swapAt_perm_cons
statement:
theorem cons_uncurry_swapAt_perm_cons : ∀ (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (v : α),
    List.cons.uncurry (swapAt xs i v) ~ v :: xs

name: swap_perm
statement:
@[simp] theorem swap_perm : ∀ (xs : List α) (i j : Nat), xs.swap i j ~ xs
  | [], _, _ => .refl []
  | _ :: _, 0, 0 => .refl (_ :: _)
  | a :: xs, 0, j+1 => getD_set_perm_cons xs j a
  | a :: xs, i+1, 0 => getD_set_perm_cons xs i a
  | a :: xs, i+1, j+1 => (swap_perm xs i j).cons a

@[simp, grind =]

name: mem_swap
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem mem_swap {xs : List α} (i j : Nat) {a : α} : a ∈ xs.swap i j ↔ a ∈ xs

name: coe_idxInj
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem coe_idxInj [BEq α] [ReflBEq α] {xs ys : List α} {h : xs <+~ ys}
    {i : Fin xs.length} :
    (h.idxInj i : Nat) = ys.idxOfNth xs[i] (xs.countBefore xs[i] i)

name: Subperm.getElem_idxInj_eq_getElem
Subperm.idxInj_injective
statement:
theorem Subperm.idxInj_injective [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {xs ys : List α}
    (h : xs <+~ ys) : h.idxInj.Injective
proof:
:= fun _ _ hij => by
  have H := congrArg (fun i : Fin ys.length => xs.idxOfNth ys[i] (ys.countBefore ys[i] i)) hij
  grind [idxOfNth_lt_length_iff]

name: Subperm.idxInj_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Subperm.idxInj_inj [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {xs ys : List α}

name: replaceF_eq_replaceFTR
statement: @[csimp] theorem replaceF_eq_replaceFTR : @replaceF = @replaceFTR
proof:
:= by

  let rec go (acc) : ∀ xs, replaceFTR.go p xs acc = acc.toList ++ xs.replaceF p
  | [] => by simp [replaceFTR.go, replaceF]
  | x::xs => by
    simp [replaceFTR.go, replaceF]; cases p x <;> simp
    · rw [go _ xs]; simp

name: foldrIdx_eq_foldrIdxTR

proof:
:= by

    (foldrIdx f i xs s, s) := by induction xs generalizing s <;> grind [foldrIdx]

name: forall
statement:
@[simp] theorem forall₂_cons {R : α → β → Prop} {a b l₁ l₂} :
    Forall₂ R (a :: l₁) (b :: l₂) ↔ R a b ∧ Forall₂ R l₁ l₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun | .cons h tail => ⟨h, tail⟩, fun ⟨head, tail⟩ => .cons head tail⟩

name: all
statement:
@[simp] theorem all₂_eq_true {r : α → β → Bool} :
    ∀ l₁ l₂, all₂ r l₁ l₂ ↔ Forall₂ (r · ·) l₁ l₂
  | [], [] => by simp [all₂]
  | a::as, b::bs => by
    by_cases h : r a b
      <;> simp [all₂, h, all₂_eq_true, forall₂_cons]
  | _::_, [] | [], _::_ => by
    simp [all₂]
    exact nofun

instance {R : α → β → Prop} [∀ a b, Decidable (R a b)] : ∀ l₁ l₂, Decidable (Forall₂ R l₁ l₂)
proof:
:=
  fun l₁ l₂ => decidable_of_iff (all₂ (R · ·) l₁ l₂) (by simp [all₂_eq_true])

name: sections_eq_nil_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem sections_eq_nil_of_isEmpty : ∀ {L}, L.any isEmpty → @sections α L = []
  | l :: L, h => by
    simp only [any, Bool.or_eq_true] at h
    match l, h with
    | [], .inl rfl => simp
    | l, .inr h => simp [sections, sections_eq_nil_of_isEmpty h]

@[csimp] theorem sections_eq_sectionsTR : @sections = @sectionsTR
proof:
:= by
  funext α L; simp [sectionsTR]
  cases e : L.any isEmpty <;> simp [sections_eq_nil_of_isEmpty, *]
  clear e; induction L with | nil => rfl | cons l L IH => ?_
  simp [IH, sectionsTR.go]
  rfl

name: takeWhile
statement: @[csimp] theorem takeWhile₂_eq_takeWhile₂TR : @takeWhile₂ = @takeWhile₂TR
proof:
:= by
  funext α β R as bs; simp [takeWhile₂TR]
  let rec go (as bs acca accb) : takeWhile₂TR.go R as bs acca accb =
      (acca.reverse ++ (as.takeWhile₂ R bs).1, accb.reverse ++ (as.takeWhile₂ R bs).2) := by
    unfold takeWhile₂TR.go takeWhile₂; split <;> simp
    rename_i a as b bs; cases R a b <;> simp [go as bs]
  exact (go as bs [] []).symm

name: dropSlice_zero
statement:
theorem dropSlice_zero₂ : ∀ n l, @dropSlice α n 0 l = l
  | 0, [] | 0, _::_ | _+1, [] => rfl
  | n+1, x::xs => by simp [dropSlice, dropSlice_zero₂]

@[csimp] theorem dropSlice_eq_dropSliceTR : @dropSlice = @dropSliceTR
proof:
:= by
  funext α n m l; simp [dropSliceTR]
  split; { rw [dropSlice_zero₂] }
  rename_i m
  let rec go (acc) : ∀ xs n, l = acc.toList ++ xs →
    dropSliceTR.go l m xs n acc = acc.toList ++ xs.dropSlice n (m+1)
  | [],    n
  | _::xs, 0 => fun h => by simp [dropSliceTR.go, dropSlice, h]
  | x::xs, n+1 => by simp [dropSliceTR.go, dropSlice]; intro h; rw [go _ xs]; {simp}; simp [h]
  exact (go #[] _ _ rfl).symm

name: dropSlice_eq_dropSliceTR
statement: @[csimp] theorem dropSlice_eq_dropSliceTR : @dropSlice = @dropSliceTR
proof:
:= by
  funext α n m l; simp [dropSliceTR]
  split; { rw [dropSlice_zero₂] }
  rename_i m
  let rec go (acc) : ∀ xs n, l = acc.toList ++ xs →
    dropSliceTR.go l m xs n acc = acc.toList ++ xs.dropSlice n (m+1)
  | [],    n
  | _::xs, 0 => fun h => by simp [dropSliceTR.go, dropSlice, h]
  | x::xs, n+1 => by simp [dropSliceTR.go, dropSlice]; intro h; rw [go _ xs]; {simp}; simp [h]
  exact (go #[] _ _ rfl).symm

name: zipWithLeft'_eq_zipWithLeft'TR
statement: @[csimp] theorem zipWithLeft'_eq_zipWithLeft'TR : @zipWithLeft' = @zipWithLeft'TR
proof:
:= by
  funext α β γ f as bs; simp [zipWithLeft'TR]
  let rec go (acc) : ∀ as bs, zipWithLeft'TR.go f as bs acc =
      let (l, r) := as.zipWithLeft' f bs; (acc.toList ++ l, r)
  | [], bs => by simp [zipWithLeft'TR.go]
  | _::_, [] => by simp [zipWithLeft'TR.go]
  | a::as, b::bs => by simp [zipWithLeft'TR.go, go _ as bs]
  simp [go]

name: zipWithLeft_eq_zipWithLeftTR

proof:

  let rec go (acc) : ∀ as bs, zipWithLeftTR.go f as bs acc = acc.toList ++ as.zipWithLeft f bs
  | [], bs => by simp [zipWithLeftTR.go]
  | _::_, [] => by simp [zipWithLeftTR.go]
  | a::as, b::bs => by simp [zipWithLeftTR.go, go _ as bs]
  simp [go]

name: takeList_eq_takeListTR
statement: @[csimp] theorem takeList_eq_takeListTR : @takeList = @takeListTR
proof:
:= by
  funext α xs ns; simp [takeListTR]
  let rec go (acc) : ∀ ns xs, @takeListTR.go α ns xs acc =
      let (l, r) := xs.takeList ns; (acc.toList ++ l, r)
  | [], xs => by simp [takeListTR.go, takeList]
  | n::ns, xs => by simp [takeListTR.go, takeList, go _ ns]
  simp [go]

name: swapAt_eq_swapAtTR
statement: @[csimp] theorem swapAt_eq_swapAtTR : @swapAt = @swapAtTR
proof:
:= by
  funext α xs i v
  let rec go : ∀ xs i (acc : Array α), swapAtTR.go (acc.toList ++ xs) v xs i acc =
        (xs[i]?.getD v, acc.toList ++ xs.set i v)
  | [], _, _ | _::_, 0, _ => by simp [swapAtTR.go]
  | a::xs, i+1, acc => by simpa [swapAtTR.go] using go xs i (acc.push a)
  exact (go xs i #[]).symm

name: swap_eq_swapTR
statement: @[csimp] theorem swap_eq_swapTR : @swap = @swapTR
proof:
:= by
  funext α l i j
  let rec go : ∀ xs i j (acc : Array α),
      swapTR.go (acc.toList ++ xs) xs i j acc = acc.toList ++ swap xs i j
  | [], _, _, _ | _::_, 0, 0, _ | _::_, 0, _+1, _ | _::_, _+1, 0, _ => by
    simp [swapTR.go, swap, swapAt]
  | x::xs, i+1, j+1, acc => by simpa [swapTR.go, swap] using go xs i j (acc.push x)
  exact (go l i j #[]).symm

theorem interleave_flatten_flatten_of_length_eq_length :
    ∀ {L₁ L₂ : List (List α)} (h₁₂ : L₁.length = L₂.length),
      (∀ i (hi : i + 1 < L₁.length), length L₁[i] = length L₂[i]) →
        L₁.flatten.interleave L₂.flatten = (zipWith interleave L₁ L₂).flatten
  | [], [], _, _ => by simp
  | [_], [_], _, _ => by simp
  | _ :: _ :: _, l :: _ :: _, _, h => by
    rw [flatten_cons, flatten_cons (l := l), zipWith_cons_cons, flatten_cons (l := interleave ..),
      interleave_append_append_of_length_eq_length (by simpa using h 0),
      interleave_flatten_flatten_of_length_eq_length (by grind) fun i => by simpa using h i.succ]

  | n + 1, _, _ => by simp_all [interleave_ofFn_ofFn_even]; grind

/
Induction along the valid positions in a list of characters.
(This definition is intended only for specification purposes.)
-/
def utf8InductionOn {motive : List Char → Pos.Raw → Sort u}
    (s : List Char) (i p : Pos.Raw)
    (nil : ∀ i, motive [] i)
    (eq  : ∀ c cs, motive (c :: cs) p)
    (ind : ∀ (c : Char) cs i, i ≠ p → motive cs (i + c) → motive (c :: cs) i) :
    motive s i
proof:
:=
  match s with
  | [] => nil i
  | c::cs =>
    if h : i = p then
      h ▸ eq c cs
    else ind c cs i h (utf8InductionOn cs (i + c) p nil eq ind)

name: utf8GetAux_add_right_cancel
statement:
theorem utf8GetAux_add_right_cancel (s : List Char) (i p n : Nat) :
    Pos.Raw.utf8GetAux s ⟨i + n⟩ ⟨p + n⟩ = Pos.Raw.utf8GetAux s ⟨i⟩ ⟨p⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply utf8InductionOn s ⟨i⟩ ⟨p⟩ (motive := fun s i =>
    Pos.Raw.utf8GetAux s ⟨i.byteIdx + n⟩ ⟨p + n⟩ = Pos.Raw.utf8GetAux s i ⟨p⟩) <;>
  simp only [Pos.Raw.utf8GetAux, Char.reduceDefault, implies_true, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq,
    Pos.Raw.byteIdx_add_char]
  intro c cs ⟨i⟩ h ih
  simp only [Pos.Raw.ext_iff, Pos.Raw.add_char_eq] at h ⊢
  simp only [Nat.add_right_cancel_iff, h, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [Nat.add_right_comm]
  exact ih

name: utf8GetAux_of_valid
statement:
theorem utf8GetAux_of_valid (cs cs' : List Char) {i p : Nat} (hp : i + utf8Len cs = p) :
    Pos.Raw.utf8GetAux (cs ++ cs') ⟨i⟩ ⟨p⟩ = cs'.headD default
proof:
:= by
  match cs, cs' with
  | [], [] => rfl
  | [], c::cs' => simp [← hp, Pos.Raw.utf8GetAux]
  | c::cs, cs' =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, Pos.Raw.utf8GetAux, Char.reduceDefault]
    rw [ite_eq_right]
    case hnc => simp only [← hp, utf8Len_cons, Pos.Raw.ext_iff]; exact ne_self_add_add_utf8Size
    refine utf8GetAux_of_valid cs cs' ?_
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm] using hp

proof:

name: findAux_of_valid
statement:
@[nolint unusedHavesSuffices] 
theorem findAux_of_valid (p) : ∀ l m r,
    Legacy.findAux (ofList (l ++ m ++ r)) p ⟨utf8Len l + utf8Len m⟩ ⟨utf8Len l⟩ =
    ⟨utf8Len l + utf8Len (m.takeWhile (!p ·))⟩
  | l, [], r => by unfold Legacy.findAux List.takeWhile; simp
  | l, c::m, r => by
    unfold Legacy.findAux List.takeWhile
    rw [dite_eq_left (by exact Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right add_utf8Size_pos)]
    have h1
proof:
:= get_of_valid l (c::m++r); have h2 := next_of_valid l c (m++r)
    simp only [List.cons_append, Char.reduceDefault, List.headD_cons] at h1 h2
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, h1, utf8Len_cons, h2]
    cases p c
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Bool.not_false, utf8Len_cons]
      have foo := findAux_of_valid p (l++[c]) m r
      simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, utf8Len_append,
        utf8Len_cons, utf8Len_nil, Nat.zero_add, List.nil_append] at foo
      rw [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_assoc] at foo
      rw [foo, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_assoc]
    · simp

statement: theorem find_of_valid (p s) : Legacy.find s p = ⟨utf8Len (s.toList.takeWhile (!p ·))⟩
proof:

name: revFindAux_of_valid
statement:
@[nolint unusedHavesSuffices] 
theorem revFindAux_of_valid (p) : ∀ l r,
    Legacy.revFindAux (ofList (l.reverse ++ r)) p ⟨utf8Len l⟩ =
      (l.dropWhile (!p ·)).tail?.map (⟨utf8Len ·⟩)
  | [], r => by unfold Legacy.revFindAux List.dropWhile; simp
  | c::l, r => by
    unfold Legacy.revFindAux List.dropWhile
    rw [dite_eq_right (by exact Pos.Raw.ne_of_gt add_utf8Size_pos)]
    have h1
proof:
:= get_of_valid l.reverse (c::r); have h2 := prev_of_valid l.reverse c r
    simp only [utf8Len_reverse, Char.reduceDefault, List.headD_cons] at h1 h2
    simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append,
      utf8Len_cons, h2, h1]
    cases p c <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Bool.not_false, Bool.not_true,
      List.tail?_cons, Option.map_some]
    exact revFindAux_of_valid p l (c::r)
